		Global.MissingPlayerCursor = 0;
		Global.VisibleIconChoices = Empty Array;
		Global.IsReady = True;
	}
}

rule("1 - Global: Start the game immediately while waiting for players")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Global.GameStartRequested == False;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is Waiting For Players == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.GameStartRequested = True;
		Start Game Mode;
	}
}

rule("6 - Team cycle: Quarantine before preparation")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller01a;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Global.IsReady, And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer)), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer), (Global.TriggerPlayer.LastTeam != Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer))))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerListUpdatePending = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman = False;
		Global.SuperPunchPlayers = Remove From Array(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LastTeam = Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam = Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.500);
		If((Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
		Global.TeamCycleTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[36] = Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[36];
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState = Empty Array;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[36] = Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[36];
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes = Empty Array;
		If((Global.TeamCyclePhaseOwner == Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TeamCyclePhaseOwner = Null;
		Global.TeamCyclePhase = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("7 - Team cycle: Preparation worker from the global scheduler")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller01b;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Global.IsReady, And(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman), And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer)), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed, And((Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.TriggerPlayer), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam == Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)), And(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleDeadline)))))))))))));
		If((Global.TeamCyclePhaseOwner != Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TeamCyclePhaseOwner = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Global.TeamCyclePhase = 0;
		Global.TeamCyclePhaseTime = 0;
		End;
		Abort If((Total Time Elapsed < Global.TeamCyclePhaseTime));
		If((Global.TeamCyclePhase == 0));
		Call Subroutine(QuiescePlayer);
		Global.TeamCyclePhase = 1;
		Global.TeamCyclePhaseTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.050);
		Else If((Global.TeamCyclePhase == 1));
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot);
		Abort If(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed));
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam != Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared);
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Call Subroutine(CleanupPlayer);
		End;
		Global.TeamCyclePhase = 2;
		Global.TeamCyclePhaseTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.050);
		Else If((Global.TeamCyclePhase == 2));
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot);
		Abort If(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed));
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam != Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared);
		Call Subroutine(PreparePlayer);
		Global.TeamCyclePhase = 3;
		End;
		If((Global.TeamCyclePhase == 3));
		Global.TeamCyclePhaseOwner = Null;
		Global.TeamCyclePhase = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("8 - Player: Classify humans and automatic bots")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller02;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[2] == 2));
		Abort If((Total Time Elapsed < Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[2]));
		If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.LastTeam != Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam != Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Stop Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsClassified = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[2] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[2] = 1;
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		If(Or(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared), Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Stop Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsClassified = False;
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Custom String("{0}", Global.TriggerPlayer) == Custom String("​")));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot = True;
		End;
		Stop Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[2] = 3;
		Else;
		Abort If(Not(And(Global.IsReady, And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer)), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Not(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared, And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive), And(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.LastTeam == Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerListUpdatePending), Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsClassified))))))))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsClassified = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NameColor = Color(White);
		If(And(Global.TriggerPlayer.WasPrepared, And((Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName != Null), (Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName != Custom String("")))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[2] = 3;
		Else;
		Start Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Custom String("​"));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[2] = 2;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[2] = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.016);
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[2] == 3));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[2] = 0;
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = 0;
		If((Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
		Global.TeamCycleTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		End;
		Cancel Primary Action(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Call Subroutine(LockBot);
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		If((Count Of(Global.AvailableHudSlots) == 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsClassified = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		If((Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
		Global.TeamCycleTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		End;
		Abort;
		End;
		If(Or(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.WasPrepared), Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName == Null), (Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName == Custom String("")))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName = Evaluate Once(Custom String("{0}", Global.TriggerPlayer));
		End;
		If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName == Null), (Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName == Custom String(""))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsClassified = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		If((Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
		Global.TeamCycleTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		End;
		Abort;
		End;
		Disable Game Mode HUD(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Disable Game Mode In-World UI(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreIndex = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorIndex = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NameColor = Global.NameColors[Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorIndex];
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName == Custom String("งูแรร์")));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CustomSoundtrack = Custom String("Draconian");
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorIndex = 2;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorCursor = 2;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NameColor = Global.NameColors[2];
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuColor = Global.NameColorRGBValues[2];
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IconIndex = 23;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IconCursor = 23;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot = First Of(Global.AvailableHudSlots);
		Global.MissingHudDeadlines[Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot] = 0;
		Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot] = 0;
		Global.LastHudSlot = Max(Global.LastHudSlot, Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot);
		Modify Global Variable(AvailableHudSlots, Remove From Array By Index, 0);
		Global.HumanPlayers = Append To Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Disable Nameplates(Global.TriggerPlayer, Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Player Variable(Current Array Element, NameplatesDisabled)));
		Global.PlayerListHudIds = Append To Array(Global.PlayerListHudIds, 0);
		Global.MenuHudIds = Append To Array(Global.MenuHudIds, 0);
		Global.InspectionTextIds = Append To Array(Global.InspectionTextIds, 0);
		Global.PlayerHudSlots = Append To Array(Global.PlayerHudSlots, Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LastHero = Hero Of(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.VoteRecountNeeded = True;
		Create HUD Text(Global.HumanPlayers, Null, Custom String("{0} {1} {2}", Global.PlayerIcons[Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), IconIndex)], Hero Icon String((Is Duplicating(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)) : Hero Of(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)))), Custom String("{0} - {1}", Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName), ((Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), CustomSoundtrack) != Null) ? Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), CustomSoundtrack) : ((Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), GenreIndex) >= 0) ? Global.GenreNames[Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), GenreIndex)] : Custom String("no soundtrack yet"))))), (And((Global.PerformanceDiagnostics == True), And((Local Player == Host Player), (Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), HudSlot) == Global.LastHudSlot))) ? Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("\n \nLOAD {0}% | AVG {1}% | MAX {2}%", Server Load, Server Load Average, Server Load Peak), Custom String("HUD {0} | IWT {1}", (((6 + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.PlayerListHudIds, (Current Array Element != 0)))) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.MenuHudIds, (Current Array Element != 0)))) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds, (Current Array Element != 0)))), ((Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.InspectionTextIds, (Current Array Element != 0))) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds, (Current Array Element != 0)))) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds, (Current Array Element != 0)))))) : Custom String("")), Left, (1 + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), HudSlot)), Color(White), Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), NameColor), Color(White), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerListHud = Last Text ID;
		If(And((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0), (Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.PlayerListHudIds))));
		Global.PlayerListHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerListHud;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerHudCreated = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MainMenuCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen = True;
		Call Subroutine(DrawMenu);
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Welcome to Cozywatch! Pick a vibe & color. Stay weird."));
		End;
	}
}

rule("9 - Bot: Lock on respawn or hero change")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller03c;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Global.IsReady, And(Or(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer), Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), Or(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.BotLocked), (Hero Of(Global.TriggerPlayer) != Global.TriggerPlayer.LastHero))))))));
		Call Subroutine(LockBot);
		If(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 1);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelCursor = 0;
		Set Respawn Max Time(Global.TriggerPlayer, 3);
		End;
	}
}

rule("10 - Subroutine: Maintain dummy bot slots for both teams at 1 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		MaintainDummyBots;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(Global.IsReady));
		Abort If(Not(Is Game In Progress));
		Abort If((Global.TeamCyclePlayer != Null));
		If((Number Of Players(Team 1) >= Number Of Slots(Team 1)));
		If((Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 1), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))) > 0));
		Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam = Team 1;
		Global.Team1DummyBotRetryTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 1);
		Call Subroutine(RemoveTeamDummyBot);
		End;
		Else;
		If(And((Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Skirmish)), And((Number Of Players(Team 1) < (Number Of Slots(Team 1) - 1)), And((Count Of(Spawn Points(Team 1)) > 0), And((Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 1), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))) == 0), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.Team1DummyBotRetryTime))))));
		Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam = Team 1;
		Global.Team1DummyBotRetryTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 1);
		Call Subroutine(CreateTeamDummyBot);
		End;
		End;
		If((Number Of Players(Team 2) >= Number Of Slots(Team 2)));
		If((Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 2), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))) > 0));
		Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam = Team 2;
		Global.Team2DummyBotRetryTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 1);
		Call Subroutine(RemoveTeamDummyBot);
		End;
		Else;
		If(And((Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Skirmish)), And((Number Of Players(Team 2) < (Number Of Slots(Team 2) - 1)), And((Count Of(Spawn Points(Team 2)) > 0), And((Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 2), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))) == 0), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.Team2DummyBotRetryTime))))));
		Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam = Team 2;
		Global.Team2DummyBotRetryTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 1);
		Call Subroutine(CreateTeamDummyBot);
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("11 - Bot: Travel from spawn to the objective")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller03f;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Global.IsReady, And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer), And((Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Skirmish)), And(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Is In Spawn Room(Global.TriggerPlayer), And((Count Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer))) > 0), Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelTime == 0), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelTime)))))))))));
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelTime == 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 1);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelCursor = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 1);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition = Objective Position(Objective Index);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition + (Direction From Angles((Horizontal Angle From Direction(Direction Towards(Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)))))) + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelCursor % 8) * 45)), 0) * ((Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelCursor < 8) ? 8 : 12))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination = Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelCursor + 1) % 16);
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition) >= 6));
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition) <= 16));
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 5, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition - Vector(0, 20, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition) <= 6));
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100));
		Teleport(Global.TriggerPlayer, Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition);
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("12 - Bot: Face and approach the nearest living enemy human")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller03g;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Not(And(Global.IsReady, And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget != Null), And(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget), And(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget, IsHuman), And(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget, AllowDummyBotFollow), And(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget), And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget), (Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget) == Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)))))))))))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[5] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[5] == 1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[5] = 1;
		Start Facing(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Direction Towards(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)), Eye Position(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), DummyBotFollowTarget))), 1000, To World, Direction and Turn Rate);
		Start Throttle In Direction(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Forward, (Or(Is In Spawn Room(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)), (Distance Between(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), DummyBotFollowTarget)) <= 4)) ? 0 : 1), To Player, Replace Existing Throttle, Direction and Magnitude);
	}
}

rule("13 - Bot: Stop moving when no enemy human is alive")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller03h;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Not(And(Global.IsReady, And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer), Or(Or(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget == Null), Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget))), Or(Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget, IsHuman)), Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget, AllowDummyBotFollow)))), Or(Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget)), Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget))), (Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget) != Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)))))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[6] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[6] == 1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[6] = 1;
		Stop Facing(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Stop Throttle In Direction(Global.TriggerPlayer);
	}
}

rule("14 - Bot: Stop moving on death")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
		}

	conditions
	{
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
		}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.EventCount < 256));
		Global.EventQueue[Global.EventQueueTail] = Array(0, Event Player, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Total Time Elapsed, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Hero Of(Event Player), Team Of(Event Player), Event Player.ControllerState[36], (Event Player.IsHuman ? Event Player.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Event Player)));
		Global.EventQueueTail = ((Global.EventQueueTail + 1) % 256);
		Global.EventCount += 1;
		Else;
		Global.DroppedEventCount += 1;
		End;
	}
}

rule("15 - Bot: Stop moving on death global")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		NativeEvent03i;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[20] != Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[36]));
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[21] != (Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman ? Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Abort If(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Stop Facing(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Stop Throttle In Direction(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget = Null;
	}
}

rule("16 - Player left: Clean up only after an actual departure")
{
	event
	{
		Player Left Match;
		All;
		All;
		}

	conditions
	{
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Or(Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == True, Or(Event Player.IsHuman == True, Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Event Player))) == True;
		}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.EventCount < 256));
		Global.EventQueue[Global.EventQueueTail] = Array(1, Event Player, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Total Time Elapsed, Null, Null, Null, Null, Event Player.IsAutomaticBot);
		Global.EventQueueTail = ((Global.EventQueueTail + 1) % 256);
		Global.EventCount += 1;
		Else;
		Global.DroppedEventCount += 1;
		End;
	}
}

rule("17 - Player left: Clean up only after an actual departure global")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		NativeEvent04;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Global.ActiveEvent[12]);
		Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
		Else;
		Global.PendingLeaveCursor = Index Of Array Value(Global.PendingLeaves, Null);
		If((Global.PendingLeaveCursor < 0));
		Global.PendingLeaveCursor = Count Of(Global.PendingLeaves);
		End;
		If((Global.PendingLeaveCursor < 24));
		Global.PendingLeaves[Global.PendingLeaveCursor] = Global.ActiveEvent;
		Else;
		Global.DroppedEventCount += 1;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("18 - Global main loop: Central scheduler at 20 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.PlayerListSnapshot = All Players(All Teams);
		Call Subroutine(ProcessGlobalEventQueue);
		Call Subroutine(ProcessGlobalLeaves);
		Global.SchedulerStep = ((Global.SchedulerStep + 1) % 200);
		If(((Global.SchedulerStep % 2) == 0));
		Global.RGB = Custom Color((80 + (((Global.RGBPhase < 255) ? 255 : ((Global.RGBPhase < 510) ? (510 - Global.RGBPhase) : ((Global.RGBPhase < 1020) ? 0 : ((Global.RGBPhase < 1275) ? (Global.RGBPhase - 1020) : 255)))) * 0.686)), (80 + (((Global.RGBPhase < 255) ? Global.RGBPhase : ((Global.RGBPhase < 765) ? 255 : ((Global.RGBPhase < 1020) ? (1020 - Global.RGBPhase) : 0))) * 0.686)), (80 + (((Global.RGBPhase < 510) ? 0 : ((Global.RGBPhase < 765) ? (Global.RGBPhase - 510) : ((Global.RGBPhase < 1275) ? 255 : (1530 - Global.RGBPhase)))) * 0.686)), 255);
		Global.RGBPhase = ((Global.RGBPhase + 3) % 1530);
		End;
		If(And(((Global.SchedulerStep % 20) == 0), Not(Global.RestartRequested)));
		Global.ServerTimeRemaining = Max(0, Round To Integer((Global.ServerEndTime - Total Time Elapsed), Up));
		Global.ServerTimeText = (((Global.ServerTimeRemaining % 60) < 10) ? Custom String("{0}:0{1}", Round To Integer((Global.ServerTimeRemaining / 60), Down), (Global.ServerTimeRemaining % 60)) : Custom String("{0}:{1}", Round To Integer((Global.ServerTimeRemaining / 60), Down), (Global.ServerTimeRemaining % 60)));
		If(And(Is Game In Progress, (Global.ServerTimeRemaining > 0)));
		Disable Built-In Game Mode Completion;
		Set Match Time(Max(1, Global.ServerTimeRemaining));
		End;
		End;
		If(And((Global.TeamCyclePlayer != Null), Or(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TeamCyclePlayer)), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TeamCyclePlayer)), Not(Array Contains(Global.PlayerListSnapshot, Global.TeamCyclePlayer))))));
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
		Global.TeamCyclePhaseOwner = Null;
		Global.TeamCycleTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		End;
		If(Is True For Any(Global.PlayerListSnapshot, Player Variable(Current Array Element, LuckPrivacyActive)));
		Global.LuckVisionViewers = Filtered Array(Global.PlayerListSnapshot, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman), Player Variable(Current Array Element, LuckPrivacyActive))));
		Else;
		If((Count Of(Global.LuckVisionViewers) > 0));
		Global.LuckVisionViewers = Empty Array;
		End;
		End;
		For Global Variable(SchedulerPlayerIndex, 0, Count Of(Global.PlayerListSnapshot), 1);
		Global.ActivePlayer = Global.PlayerListSnapshot[Global.SchedulerPlayerIndex];
		Global.TriggerPlayer = Global.ActivePlayer;
		Call Subroutine(ProcessGlobalController);
		If(And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer)), Not(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot)));
		Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerFastState);
		If(Array Contains(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
		Call Subroutine(ProcessSuperPunch);
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpEnabled);
		Call Subroutine(ProcessMultijump);
		End;
		If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive, Or((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount > 0), Or((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 0), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime > 0)))));
		Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerLuck);
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive));
		Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerFlight);
		End;
		If(((Global.SchedulerStep % 2) == ((Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman ? Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot : Slot Of(Global.ActivePlayer)) % 2)));
		Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerCycle);
		End;
		If(((Global.SchedulerStep % 20) == ((Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman ? Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot : Slot Of(Global.ActivePlayer)) % 20)));
		If(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionComplete));
		If(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer));
		Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionComplete = True;
		Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = 0;
		Else;
		If(Or((Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer) == Team 1), (Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer) == Team 2)));
		If(And((Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline > 0), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline)));
		Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionComplete = True;
		Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = 0;
		Start Forcing Player To Be Hero(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer), Hero(Shion));
		Stop Forcing Player To Be Hero(Global.ActivePlayer);
		End;
		Else;
		Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.AllowDummyBotFollow, And(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen, Or((Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage == 2), (Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage == 4))))));
		Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerMaintenance);
		End;
		End;
		Else;
		If(((Global.SchedulerStep % 2) == (Slot Of(Global.ActivePlayer) % 2)));
		Call Subroutine(ProcessPlayerBot);
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer = Null;
		Global.ActivePlayer = Null;
		Global.PlayerListSnapshot = Empty Array;
		If(((Global.SchedulerStep % 20) == 0));
		Call Subroutine(MaintainDummyBots);
		Call Subroutine(UpdateSocialObjectiveIcons);
		Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
		Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
		End;
		Call Subroutine(ProcessVisibleIcons);
		If(Global.VoteRecountNeeded);
		Global.VoteRecountNeeded = False;
		Call Subroutine(RecountVotes);
		End;
		Wait(0.050, Ignore Condition);
		Loop If Condition Is True;
	}
}

rule("19 - Menu: Hold Melee for 0.5 seconds to open or close")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller05;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Not(And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.MeleeConsumed), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckActive), Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Melee))))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[7] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[7] == 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[7] = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.500);
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Total Time Elapsed < Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[7]));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[7] = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MeleeConsumed = True;
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen);
		Call Subroutine(CloseMenu);
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage = -1;
		Call Subroutine(DrawMenu);
		End;
	}
}

rule("20 - Menu: Release Melee before using it again")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller05b;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Global.TriggerPlayer.MeleeConsumed, Not(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Melee))))));
		If(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Melee));
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MeleeConsumed = False;
	}
}

rule("21 - Menu: Input controller with fixed priority")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller05c;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen, And(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Crouch)), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 0), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraInteractConsumed), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckActive), Or(Or(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Interact)), And(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Reload)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage != -1))), Or(Or(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Primary Fire)), Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Secondary Fire))), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 3), Or(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 1)), Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 2))))))))))))));
		If(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Interact)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraInteractConsumed = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 1;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Reload)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage != -1)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 2;
		Else If(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Primary Fire)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 3;
		Else If(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Secondary Fire)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 4;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 1)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 3)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 5;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 2)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 3)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 6;
		End;
	}
}

rule("25 - Menu: Navigate forward and backward")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller06;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Not(And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen, Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3), (Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 4))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[13] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[13] == 1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[13] = 1;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == -1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MainMenuCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MainMenuCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : 15)) % 16);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : (Count Of(Global.NameColors) - 1))) % Count Of(Global.NameColors));
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 2));
		Call Subroutine(RefreshCameraTargets);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : (Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets) + 1))) % (Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets) + 2));
		Else If(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 3), (Global.TriggerPlayer.CustomSoundtrack == Null)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : (Count Of(Global.GenreNames) - 1))) % Count Of(Global.GenreNames));
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 4));
		Call Subroutine(RefreshRevengeTargets);
		If((Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets) > 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : (Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets) - 1))) % Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets));
		End;
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 5));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : 2)) % 3);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 6));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : 4)) % 5);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 7));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IconCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.IconCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : (Count Of(Global.PlayerIcons) - 1))) % Count Of(Global.PlayerIcons));
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 11));
		If((Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) > 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VoteCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.VoteCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : (Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) - 1))) % Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers));
		End;
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 13));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyCursor + 1) % 2);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 14));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 3) ? 1 : 10)) % 11);
		End;
		Call Subroutine(TransitionMenuColor);
	}
}

rule("26 - Soundtrack menu: Jump forward or backward by ten genres")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller08;
	}

	actions

		If(Not(And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen, And((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 3), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.CustomSoundtrack == Null), Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 5), (Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 6))))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[14] = 0;

		End;
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[14] == 1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[14] = 1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 5) ? 10 : (Count Of(Global.GenreNames) - 10))) % Count Of(Global.GenreNames));
	}
}

rule("27 - Menu: Apply the active page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller10;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Not(And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen, (Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 1)))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[15] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[15] == 1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[15] = 1;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == -1));
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MainMenuCursor == 8));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyCrouchTravel);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MainMenuCursor == 9));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyInspectionPrivacyPage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MainMenuCursor == 12));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyDummyBotFollowPage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MainMenuCursor == 15));
		Call Subroutine(ApplySuperPunchPage);
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage = Global.TriggerPlayer.MainMenuCursor;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 2));
		Call Subroutine(RefreshCameraTargets);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 4));
		Call Subroutine(RefreshRevengeTargets);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 5));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableCursor = Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableMode;
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 11));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VoteCursor = (And((Global.TriggerPlayer.VotedPlayer != Null), Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer.VotedPlayer)) ? Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer.VotedPlayer) : Min(Global.TriggerPlayer.VoteCursor, Max(0, (Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) - 1))));
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 13));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyCursor %= 2;
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 14));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpCursor = (Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpEnabled ? Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpLevel : 0);
		End;
		Call Subroutine(DrawMenu);
		End;
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 1));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyNameColorPage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 2));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyCameraPage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 3));
		Call Subroutine(ApplySoundtrackPage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 4));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyRevengePage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 5));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyUnkillablePage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 6));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyHeroVoicePage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 7));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyPlayerIconPage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 10));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyLuckPage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 11));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyVotePage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 13));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyGhostFlyPage);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 14));
		Call Subroutine(ApplyMultijumpPage);
		End;
	}
}

rule("28 - Subroutine: Apply the Soundtrack page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplySoundtrackPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CustomSoundtrack != Null));
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreIndex != Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreCursor));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreIndex = Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreCursor;
		End;
	}
}

rule("29 - Subroutine: Apply the Camera page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyCameraPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(RefreshCameraTargets);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor %= (Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets) + 2);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor == 0));
		Stop Camera(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTarget = Null;
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor == 1));
		Stop Camera(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode = 1;
		Global.CameraPlayer = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
		Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		Else;
		If(((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor - 2) < Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate = Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets[(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor - 2)];
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate = Null;
		End;
		If(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate != Null), Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate)));
		Stop Camera(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode = 2;
		Global.CameraPlayer = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
		Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		Else;
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Camera target unavailable. Poof!"));
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("30 - Subroutine: Apply the Name Color page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyNameColorPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorIndex != Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorCursor));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorIndex = Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorCursor;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NameColor = Global.NameColors[Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorIndex];
		If((Global.VoteLeader == Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.VoteLeaderColor = Global.TriggerPlayer.NameColor;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("31 - Subroutine: Apply the Revenge page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyRevengePage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget != Null), And(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget), (Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget, RevengeClaimant) == Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Revenge pending. Debt drops when the target dies."));
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
		Call Subroutine(RefreshRevengeTargets);
		If((Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets) == 0));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("No revenge targets. Peace wins!"));
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor %= Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets[Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor];
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeKillers, Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeIndex < 0));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("No revenge debt on that player."));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeDebts[Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeIndex] <= 0));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Revenge debt cleared. Case closed!"));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
		Else If(Or(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget)), Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget))));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Revenge target already down."));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
		Else If(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget, RevengeDeathPending));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Revenge pending on that target."));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
		Else If(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget, LuckActive));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Target busy with Try Your Luck."));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget = Null;
		Else;
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget, RevengeDeathPending, True);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget, RevengeClaimant, Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget, NextForcedRevengeTime, Total Time Elapsed);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget, ForcedRevengeEndTime, (Total Time Elapsed + 5));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Revenge on {0}. Confirming the kill.", Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedRevengeTarget));
		End;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("32 - Subroutine: Apply the Unkillable page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyUnkillablePage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableMode != Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableCursor));
		If(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableCursor == 1), Is In Spawn Room(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("1 HP is disabled in spawn. FULL HP works."));
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableMode = Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableCursor;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableActive = (Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableMode != 0);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableMode == 0));
		Clear Status(Global.TriggerPlayer, Unkillable);
		Set Damage Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		If(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Set Player Health(Global.TriggerPlayer, Max Health(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon != Null));
		Destroy Icon(Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)]] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		Else;
		Clear Status(Global.TriggerPlayer, Unkillable);
		Set Status(Global.TriggerPlayer, Null, Unkillable, 9999);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableMode == 1));
		Set Damage Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		If(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Set Player Health(Global.TriggerPlayer, 1);
		End;
		Else;
		Set Damage Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 0);
		Set Knockback Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 0);
		Disable Movement Collision With Players(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		If(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Set Player Health(Global.TriggerPlayer, Max Health(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon != Null));
		Destroy Icon(Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)]] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableMode == 1));
		Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Warning, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(255, 80, 80, 255), True);
		Else;
		Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Halo, Visible To and Position, Global.RGB, True);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon = Last Created Entity;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)]] = Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("33 - Subroutine: Apply the Hero Voice page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyHeroVoicePage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceIndex != Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceCursor));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceIndex = Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceCursor;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceIndex == 0));
		Stop Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceIndex == 1));
		Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Global.TriggerPlayer, 0.500, False);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceIndex == 2));
		Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Global.TriggerPlayer, 0.750, False);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceIndex == 3));
		Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Global.TriggerPlayer, 1.250, False);
		Else;
		Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Global.TriggerPlayer, 1.500, False);
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("37 - Subroutine: Apply the Try Your Luck page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyLuckPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckActive);
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Try Your Luck already active."));
		Else If(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeDeathPending);
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Under Revenge. Try Your Luck is locked."));
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckActive = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffect = Random Integer(1, 6);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckSpinCount = Random Integer(20, 24);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckSpinInterval = 0.080;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextLuckSpinTime = Total Time Elapsed;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckPrivacyActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIcon != Null));
		Destroy Icon(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIcon);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)]] = 0;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("38 - Subroutine: Apply the Vote page")

	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyVotePage;
	}

		Global.TriggerPlayer.VoteCursor %= Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.VotedPlayer != Global.HumanPlayers[Global.TriggerPlayer.VoteCursor]));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VotedPlayer = Global.HumanPlayers[Global.TriggerPlayer.VoteCursor];
		Global.VoteRecountNeeded = True;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("40 - Subroutine: Apply the Ghost / Fly page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyGhostFlyPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyCursor == 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostModeActive = Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostModeActive);
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyModeActive = Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyModeActive);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
		Call Subroutine(ApplyGhostFlyPhysics);
	}
}

rule("41 - Subroutine: Apply Ghost / Fly physics")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyGhostFlyPhysics;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostModeActive);
		Disable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.TriggerPlayer, False);
		Else;
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyModeActive);
		If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffect != 2), (Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed)));
		Set Move Speed(Global.TriggerPlayer, 0);
		End;
		Set Gravity(Global.TriggerPlayer, 0);
		Else;
		If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffect != 2), (Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed)));
		Set Move Speed(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		If((Magnitude Of(Velocity Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)) > 0.010));
		Apply Impulse(Global.TriggerPlayer, (Velocity Of(Global.TriggerPlayer) * -1), Magnitude Of(Velocity Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)), To World, Incorporate Contrary Motion);
		End;
		End;
		Set Gravity(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = True;
	}
}

rule("42 - Menu: Reload returns from a submenu to the main menu")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller11;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Not(And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen, And((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage != -1), (Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand == 2))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[16] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[16] == 1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[16] = 1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage = -1;
		Call Subroutine(DrawMenu);
	}
}

rule("43 - Camera: Hold Interact for half a second to switch")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller12c;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Not(And(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraInteractConsumed), And(Not(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Crouch))), Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Interact))))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[17] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[17] == 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[17] = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.500);
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Total Time Elapsed < Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[17]));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes[17] = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraInteractConsumed = True;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode == 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode = 1;
		Global.CameraPlayer = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
		Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		Else;
		Stop Camera(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTarget = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("45 - Jump revive: Store the death position")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
		}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
		}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.EventCount < 256));
		Global.EventQueue[Global.EventQueueTail] = Array(2, Event Player, Null, Null, Null, Null, Position Of(Event Player), Total Time Elapsed, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Hero Of(Event Player), Team Of(Event Player), Event Player.ControllerState[36], (Event Player.IsHuman ? Event Player.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Event Player)));
		Global.EventQueueTail = ((Global.EventQueueTail + 1) % 256);
		Global.EventCount += 1;
		Else;
		Global.DroppedEventCount += 1;
		End;
	}
}

rule("46 - Jump revive: Store the death position global")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		NativeEvent12e;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[20] != Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[36]));
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[21] != (Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman ? Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Abort If(Or(Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive, (Global.TriggerPlayer.LastTeam != Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Abort If(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition = Global.ActiveEvent[6];
		Stop Accelerating(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Set Move Speed(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Set Gravity(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCommand = 0;
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Press {0}: revive here. Void death? Back to walkable ground.", Input Binding String(Button(Jump))));
	}
}

rule("47 - Jump revive: Revive at a safe walkable position")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller12f;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer)), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.JumpReviveConsumed), Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Jump))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.JumpReviveConsumed = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position(Position Of(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ReviveTeleportNeeded = Or((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition - Vector(0, 3, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition) > 2.500), (Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition) > 0.500));
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.ReviveTeleportNeeded);
		Teleport(Global.TriggerPlayer, (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.500, 0)));
		End;
		Resurrect(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.ReviveTeleportNeeded);
		Teleport(Global.TriggerPlayer, (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.500, 0)));
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ReviveTeleportNeeded = False;
		If(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
		Call Subroutine(ApplyGhostFlyPhysics);
		End;
	}
}

rule("49 - Hero inspection: Name follows the aim target")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller13;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckPrivacyActive), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelEnabled), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode != 2), And(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Crouch)), Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget != Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate), Or(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText != Null), Or(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget)), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget)), Or(Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget)), And(And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget)), Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget, IsAutomaticBot))), Or(Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget, IsHuman)), Or(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget, InspectionPrivacyActive), Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget, PlayerListUpdatePending)))))))), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText == Null), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate != Null), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.TriggerPlayer.NextTargetTextTime))))))))))))));
		If(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionActive));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionActive = True;
		Disable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NameplatesDisabled = True;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText != Null));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText);
		End;
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds)));
		Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText = Null;
		Call Subroutine(RefreshInspectionTarget);
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget == Null));
		Abort If((Total Time Elapsed < Global.TriggerPlayer.NextTargetTextTime));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextTargetTextTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		Create In-World Text(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Custom String("{0} {1} | {2}", Hero Icon String((Is Duplicating(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget)) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget)) : Hero Of(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget)))), Evaluate Once((Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget) ? Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget, DisplayName) : Custom String("{0}", (Is Duplicating(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget) : Hero Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget))))), Round To Integer(Health(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget)), Down)), Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget)) + Vector(0, 0.450, 0))), 1.100, Do Not Clip, Visible To Position String and Color, Evaluate Once((Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget) ? Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget, NameColor) : Color(Orange))), Visible Never);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText = Last Text ID;
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds)));
		Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

Event Player.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Event Player)), Null, Player Variable(Event Player.RevengeClaimant, ControllerState)[36], Player Variable(Attacker, ControllerState)[36]);

rule("53 - Revenge: Record only the direct killer global")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		NativeEvent17;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[20] != Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[36]));
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[21] != (Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman ? Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Abort If(Or(Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive, (Global.TriggerPlayer.LastTeam != Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		If(Global.ActiveEvent[8]);
		If(Global.ActiveEvent[17]);
		If(And((Global.ActiveEvent[9] != Null), And(And(Entity Exists(Global.ActiveEvent[9]), (Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], ControllerState)[36] == Global.ActiveEvent[23])), And(Global.ActiveEvent[10], (Global.ActiveEvent[2] == Global.ActiveEvent[9])))));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], RevengeIndex, Index Of Array Value(Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], RevengeKillers), Global.TriggerPlayer));
		If(And((Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], RevengeIndex) >= 0), (Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], RevengeDebts)[Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], RevengeIndex)] > 0)));
		Modify Player Variable At Index(Global.ActiveEvent[9], RevengeDebts, Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], RevengeIndex), Subtract, 1);
		Small Message(Global.ActiveEvent[9], Custom String("Revenge on {0}: paid! Still owed: {1}.", Global.TriggerPlayer, Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], RevengeDebts)[Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], RevengeIndex)]));
		End;
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], LockedRevengeTarget, Null);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeDeathPending = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeClaimant = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		If(And((Global.ActiveEvent[9] != Null), And(Entity Exists(Global.ActiveEvent[9]), (Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], ControllerState)[36] == Global.ActiveEvent[23]))));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[9], LockedRevengeTarget, Null);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeDeathPending = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeClaimant = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Else;
		Abort;
		End;
		End;
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[2] == Null));
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[2] == Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Abort If(Not(Global.ActiveEvent[11]));
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.ActiveEvent[2])));
		Abort If((Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[2], ControllerState)[36] != Global.ActiveEvent[24]));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeKillers, Global.ActiveEvent[2]);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeIndex < 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeKillers = Append To Array(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeKillers, Global.ActiveEvent[2]);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeDebts = Append To Array(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeDebts, 1);
		Else;
		Modify Player Variable At Index(Global.TriggerPlayer, RevengeDebts, Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeIndex, Add, 1);
		End;
	}
}

		Subroutine;

		End;
		End;

	}

rule("55 - Luck: Clear effects on death")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
		}

	conditions
	{
		Or(Event Player.LuckActive == True, Or(Event Player.LuckSpinCount > 0, Event Player.LuckEffect != 0)) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
		}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.EventCount < 256));
		Global.EventQueue[Global.EventQueueTail] = Array(5, Event Player, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Total Time Elapsed, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Not(Event Player.MenuOpen), Null, Null, Null, Hero Of(Event Player), Team Of(Event Player), Event Player.ControllerState[36], (Event Player.IsHuman ? Event Player.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Event Player)));
		Global.EventQueueTail = ((Global.EventQueueTail + 1) % 256);
		Global.EventCount += 1;
		Else;
		Global.DroppedEventCount += 1;
		End;
	}
}

{

		Subroutine;
		Controller18i;
	}

	{

		End;
		Abort If((Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0));
		If(Or((Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0), Or((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0), (Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0))));
		Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
		Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0));
		Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupIndex] = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		End;
		Create In-World Text(Filtered Array(Global.LuckVisionViewers, And((Current Array Element != Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)), And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman), Player Variable(Current Array Element, LuckPrivacyActive))))), Custom String("{0} {1} | {2}", Hero Icon String((Is Duplicating(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)) : Hero Of(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)))), (Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), IsHuman) ? Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), DisplayName) : Custom String("{0}", Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer))), Round To Integer(Health(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)), Down)), Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer)) + Vector(0, 0.450, 0))), 1.100, Do Not Clip, Visible To Position String and Color, (Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), IsHuman) ? Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), NameColor) : Color(Orange)), Visible Never);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText = Last Text ID;
		Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText;
	}
