rule("64 - Crouch Travel: Navigate five pages with Primary and Secondary Fire")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller19c;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Not(And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive, Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCommand == 1), (Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCommand == 2)))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[30] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[30] == 1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[30] = 1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCursor = ((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCursor + ((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCommand == 1) ? 1 : 4)) % 5);
		If(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCursor != 2), (Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCursor != 3)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] == Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText);
		Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget = Null;
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.NameplatesDisabled);
		Enable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NameplatesDisabled = False;
		End;
		Else;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText != Null));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText);
		End;
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds)));
		Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionActive = False;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] == Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText);
		Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget = Null;
		Call Subroutine(RefreshTravelTarget);
		End;
		Call Subroutine(TransitionMenuColor);
	}
}

rule("65 - Crouch Travel: Recreate the name when the target changes")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller19d;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Or(Array Contains(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer), Array Contains(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null)), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive, And(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCursor == 2), (Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCursor == 3)), And(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Crouch)), Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget != Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate), Or(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText != Null), Or(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget)), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget)), Or(Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget)), And(And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget)), Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget, IsAutomaticBot))), Or(Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget, IsHuman)), Or(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget, InspectionPrivacyActive), Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget, PlayerListUpdatePending)))))))), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText == Null), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate != Null), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.TriggerPlayer.NextTargetTextTime))))))))))));
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] == Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText);
		Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate;
		If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate == Null), Or(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate)), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate)), Or(Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate)), And(And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate)), Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate, IsAutomaticBot))), Or(Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate, IsHuman)), Or(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate, InspectionPrivacyActive), Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate, PlayerListUpdatePending)))))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget = Null;
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Total Time Elapsed < Global.TriggerPlayer.NextTargetTextTime));
		If(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.NameplatesDisabled));
		Disable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NameplatesDisabled = True;
		End;
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer);
		If((Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0));
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
		If((Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0));
		Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
		Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0));
		If(Or((Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0), Or((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0), (Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupIndex] != 0))));
		Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
		Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Null);
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TextCleanupIndex < 0));
		Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupIndex] = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextTargetTextTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		Create In-World Text(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Custom String("{0} {1} | {2}", Hero Icon String((Is Duplicating(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate)) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate)) : Hero Of(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate)))), Evaluate Once((Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate) ? Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate, DisplayName) : Custom String("{0}", (Is Duplicating(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate) : Hero Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate))))), Round To Integer(Health(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate)), Down)), Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate)) + Vector(0, 0.450, 0))), 1.100, Do Not Clip, Visible To Position String and Color, Evaluate Once((Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate) ? Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate, NameColor) : Color(Orange))), Visible Never);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText = Last Text ID;
		Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate;
	}
}

rule("66 - Crouch Travel: Interact applies the active page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller19e;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Not(And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive, (Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCommand == 3))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[32] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[32] == 1));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[32] = 1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType = Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCursor;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget = Null;
		If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType == 2), (Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType == 3)));
		Call Subroutine(RefreshTravelTarget);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType == 0));
		Call Subroutine(TravelToSpawn);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType == 1));
		Call Subroutine(TravelToObjective);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType == 2));
		Call Subroutine(TravelToPlayer);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType == 3));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain = Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentCycleDetected = False;
		For Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, AttachmentChainIndex, 0, (Count Of(All Players(All Teams)) + 1), 1);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain != Null));
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain == Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentCycleDetected = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain = Null;
		Else If(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain, TravelAttachmentActive));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain = Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain, TravelAttachmentTarget);
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain = Null;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain != Null));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentCycleDetected = True;
		End;
		If(Or(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget == Null), Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget))), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget)), Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget)))));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Attach target unavailable."));
		Else If(Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentCycleDetected);
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Attach blocked: no loops allowed!"));
		Else;
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentActive);
		Detach Players(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentOwnerHero = Hero Of(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentTargetHero = Hero Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentActive = True;
		Attach Players(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), TravelAttachmentTarget), Vector(0, ((Y Component Of(Eye Position(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), TravelAttachmentTarget))) - Y Component Of(Position Of(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), TravelAttachmentTarget)))) + 0.750), 0));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Attached to {0}. CROUCH + RELOAD: detach.", Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget));
		End;
		Else;
		If((Total Time Elapsed >= Global.TriggerPlayer.NextSuicideTime));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextSuicideTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 3);
		Clear Status(Global.TriggerPlayer, Unkillable);
		Set Damage Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Kill(Global.TriggerPlayer, Null);
		Else;
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Self Elimination: ready in {0}s.", Round To Integer((Global.TriggerPlayer.NextSuicideTime - Total Time Elapsed), Up)));
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget = Null;
	}
}

rule("67 - Crouch Travel: Reload detaches the player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller19f;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentActive, And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen), And(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Crouch)), Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Reload)))))))));
		Detach Players(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, TravelAttachmentActive, False);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, TravelAttachmentTarget, Null);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, AttachmentOwnerHero, Null);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, AttachmentTargetHero, Null);
	}
}

rule("68 - Crouch Travel: Detach when player state changes")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller19h;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentActive, Or(Or(Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer)), Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer))), Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget == Null), Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget)))), Or(Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget)), Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget))), Or(Or((Hero Of(Global.TriggerPlayer) != Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentOwnerHero), (Hero Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget) != Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentTargetHero)), Or(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget, PlayerCycleActive), And(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget, IsHuman), Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget, InspectionPrivacyActive)))))))))));
		Detach Players(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, TravelAttachmentActive, False);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, TravelAttachmentTarget, Null);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, AttachmentOwnerHero, Null);
		Set Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, AttachmentTargetHero, Null);
	}
}

rule("69 - Crouch Travel: Close when Crouch is released")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		Controller19g;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed), And(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive), And(Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive, Or(Or(Or(Not(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Crouch))), Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer)), Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer)))), Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckPrivacyActive))))));
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud != Null));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud);
		End;
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds)));
		Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCommand = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargets = Empty Array;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] == Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText);
		Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget = Null;
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.NameplatesDisabled);
		Enable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NameplatesDisabled = False;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText != Null));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText);
		End;
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds)));
		Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargets = Empty Array;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionActive = False;
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Interact));
	}
}

rule("70 - Subroutine: Process fast player state")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerFastState;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionComplete), (Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline == 0)));
		If(Or((Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer) == Team 1), (Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer) == Team 2)));
		Global.ActivePlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = (Total Time Elapsed + 60);
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer), And(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.DisplayName == Null), (Global.ActivePlayer.DisplayName == Custom String(""))), (Custom String("{0}", Global.ActivePlayer) != Custom String("")))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.DisplayName = Evaluate Once(Custom String("{0}", Global.ActivePlayer));
		End;
		If(And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive), And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer)), And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer), Or(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman), Not(Global.ActivePlayer.WasPrepared)))))));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.DisplayName == Custom String("งูแรร์")));
		Global.ActivePlayer.CustomSoundtrack = Custom String("Draconian");
		If(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.WasPrepared));
		Global.ActivePlayer.ColorIndex = 2;
		Global.ActivePlayer.ColorCursor = 2;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NameColor = Global.NameColors[2];
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuColor = Global.NameColorRGBValues[2];
		Global.ActivePlayer.IconIndex = 23;
		Global.ActivePlayer.IconCursor = 23;
		End;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman = True;
		Global.ActivePlayer.IsClassified = True;
		Global.ActivePlayer.IsPrepared = True;
		Global.ActivePlayer.WasPrepared = True;
		End;
		If(And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer)), And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Not(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)), Or(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed), (Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam != Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer)))))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = True;
		Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.IsPrepared = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam = Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer);
		Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		If((Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.ActivePlayer));
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
		Global.TeamCyclePhaseOwner = Null;
		Global.TeamCycleTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		End;
		End;
		If(And((Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Null), And(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed, And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Or(Not(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)), Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive), And((Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam == Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer)), And(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer), And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), And((Total Time Elapsed >= Global.TeamCycleTime), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleDeadline))))))))));
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Global.ActivePlayer;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending, And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive, And((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 3), And((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount == 0), (Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime > 0)))))));
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending, Or((Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant == Null), Or(Not(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant)), Not(Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant, IsHuman))))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant = Null;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Else If(And((Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime > 0), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime)));
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending);
		Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant, Custom String("Revenge failed. Debt unchanged."));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant, LockedRevengeTarget, Null);
		Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant = Null;
		Else;
		Call Subroutine(RestoreActivePlayerLuck);
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = Not(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen);
		Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("SKULL failed. Menu restored."));
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Else If(And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), And(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable);
		Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Kill(Global.ActivePlayer, (Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending ? Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeClaimant : Null));
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, And(Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableActive, And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeDeathPending), And(Not(And(And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive, (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount == 0)), Or(And((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 3), (Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime > 0)), And((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime > Total Time Elapsed))))), And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer)))))));
		If(And((Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode == 1), Not(Is In Spawn Room(Global.ActivePlayer))));
		If(Or(Not(Has Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable)), Or((Hero Of(Global.ActivePlayer) != Global.ActivePlayer.LastHero), ((Global.SchedulerStep % 20) == (Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot % 20)))));
		If(Not(Has Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable)));
		Set Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Null, Unkillable, 9999);
		End;
		Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.ActivePlayer);
		End;
		If((Health(Global.ActivePlayer) >= Max Health(Global.ActivePlayer)));
		Set Player Health(Global.ActivePlayer, 1);
		End;
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode == 2));
		If(Or(Not(Has Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable)), Or((Hero Of(Global.ActivePlayer) != Global.ActivePlayer.LastHero), ((Global.SchedulerStep % 20) == (Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot % 20)))));
		If(Not(Has Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable)));
		Set Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Null, Unkillable, 9999);
		End;
		Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 0);
		Set Knockback Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 0);
		Disable Movement Collision With Players(Global.ActivePlayer);
		End;
		If((Health(Global.ActivePlayer) < Max Health(Global.ActivePlayer)));
		Set Player Health(Global.ActivePlayer, Max Health(Global.ActivePlayer));
		End;
		End;
		If(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableIcon == Null), Not(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableIcon))));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode == 1));
		Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer), Warning, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(255, 80, 80, 255), True);
		Else;
		Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer), Halo, Visible To and Position, Global.RGB, True);
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableIcon = Last Created Entity;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
		Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)]] = Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableIcon;
		End;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("71 - Subroutine: Process 3D flight per player at 20 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerFlight;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer)), And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), And(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer), And(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive, Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied)))))));
		If(And((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime > Total Time Elapsed)));
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyPercent = 100;
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyDirection = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Else;
		Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 0);
		If((Magnitude Of(Vector(X Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer)), 0, Z Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer)))) > 0.050));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime < 0));
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = Total Time Elapsed;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyPercent = Min(1000, (100 + (Max(0, (Total Time Elapsed - Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime)) * 45)));
		Else;
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyPercent = 100;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyDirection = (((Facing Direction Of(Global.ActivePlayer) * Max(0, Z Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer)))) + (Direction From Angles(Horizontal Facing Angle Of(Global.ActivePlayer), 0) * Min(0, Z Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer))))) + (Cross Product(Vector(0, 1, 0), Direction From Angles(Horizontal Facing Angle Of(Global.ActivePlayer), 0)) * X Component Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer))));
		If((Magnitude Of(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyDirection) > 0.050));
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta = (((((Normalize(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyDirection) * 5.500) * Global.ActivePlayer.FlyPercent) / 100) * Min(1, Magnitude Of(Throttle Of(Global.ActivePlayer)))) - Velocity Of(Global.ActivePlayer));
		Else;
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta = (Velocity Of(Global.ActivePlayer) * -1);
		End;
		If((Magnitude Of(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta) > 0.010));
		Apply Impulse(Global.ActivePlayer, Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta, Magnitude Of(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyVelocityDelta), To World, Incorporate Contrary Motion);
		End;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("72 - Subroutine: Process the player cycle at 10 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerCycle;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer)), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer)), Not(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer)))))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		If(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 2), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed)));
		Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Global.ActivePlayer);
		Set Gravity(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.ActivePlayer);
		Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer)), And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer))))));
		If(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied));
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		If(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 2), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed)));
		Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, (Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive ? 0 : 100));
		End;
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Global.ActivePlayer);
		Set Gravity(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.ActivePlayer);
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.GhostModeActive);
		Disable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.ActivePlayer, False);
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive);
		Set Gravity(Global.ActivePlayer, 0);
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = True;
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer))));
		If(And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen), And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive), And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.CrouchTravelActive), And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.CrouchTravelEnabled), And((Global.ActivePlayer.CameraMode != 2), Is Button Held(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Crouch))))))));
		Call Subroutine(RefreshActivePlayerPublicTargets);
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, InspectionTargetCandidate, ((Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets) == 0) ? Null : First Of(Sorted Array(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets, Angle Between Vectors(Facing Direction Of(Global.ActivePlayer), Direction Towards(Eye Position(Global.ActivePlayer), Eye Position(Current Array Element)))))));
		Else;
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, InspectionTargetCandidate, Null);
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.CrouchTravelActive, And(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.TravelCursor == 2), (Global.ActivePlayer.TravelCursor == 3)), Is Button Held(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Crouch)))));
		Call Subroutine(RefreshActivePlayerPublicTargets);
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, TravelTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets);
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, TravelTargetCandidate, ((Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.TravelTargets) == 0) ? Null : First Of(Sorted Array(Global.ActivePlayer.TravelTargets, Angle Between Vectors(Facing Direction Of(Global.ActivePlayer), Direction Towards(Eye Position(Global.ActivePlayer), Eye Position(Current Array Element)))))));
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerHudCreated))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = 0;
		If((Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.ActivePlayer));
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
		Global.TeamCycleTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.CameraMode == 2));
		If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget.PlayerCycleActive, Or(Or(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget == Null), Not(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget))), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget)), Not(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget)))), And(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget.IsHuman, Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget.InspectionPrivacyActive))));
		Stop Camera(Global.ActivePlayer);
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraMode, 0);
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraTarget, Null);
		Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("Camera target unavailable/private."));
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), (Hero Of(Global.ActivePlayer) != Global.ActivePlayer.LastHero))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.LastHero = Hero Of(Global.ActivePlayer);
		Global.ActivePlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		If(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 2), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed)));
		Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		End;
		If(Or(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive, Or((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount > 0), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 0))));
		Call Subroutine(RestoreActivePlayerLuck);
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = Not(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen);
		End;
		If(And((Global.ActivePlayer.CameraMode != 0), And((Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget != Null), Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTarget))));
		Stop Camera(Global.ActivePlayer);
		Global.CameraPlayer = Global.ActivePlayer;
		Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
		Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionActive, Or(Or(Or(Or(Or(Or(Not(Is Button Held(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Crouch))), Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen), Not(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer))), Not(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer))), (Global.ActivePlayer.CameraMode == 2)), And(Global.ActivePlayer.CrouchTravelActive, And((Global.ActivePlayer.TravelCursor != 2), (Global.ActivePlayer.TravelCursor != 3)))), Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive)));
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.NameplatesDisabled);
		Enable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Global.ActivePlayer);
		Global.ActivePlayer.NameplatesDisabled = False;
		End;
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionText != Null));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionText);
		End;
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds)));
		Global.InspectionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionText = Null;
		Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTarget = Null;
		Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets = Empty Array;
		Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionActive = False;
		End;
	}
}

rule("73 - Subroutine: Maintain bots at 10 Hz and follow targets at 5 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerBot;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(((Global.SchedulerStep % 4) == (Slot Of(Global.ActivePlayer) % 4)));
		If(And(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer), And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer))));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, InspectionTargets, Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, AllowDummyBotFollow), And(Has Spawned(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), (Team Of(Current Array Element) == Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer))))))))));
		If((Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets) > 0));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, DummyBotFollowTarget, First Of(Sorted Array(Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets, Distance Between(Global.ActivePlayer, Current Array Element))));
		Else;
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, DummyBotFollowTarget, Null);
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot, And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsClassified, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), And(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer), Global.ActivePlayer.BotLocked))))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = 0;
		If((Global.TeamCyclePlayer == Global.ActivePlayer));
		Global.TeamCyclePlayer = Null;
		Global.TeamCycleTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.250);
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.IsReady, And(Or(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer), Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot), And(Global.ActivePlayer.BotLocked, Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer)), Not(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer)))))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.BotLocked = False;
		End;
	}
}

rule("74 - Subroutine: Process player maintenance at 1 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerMaintenance;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer)));
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.AllowDummyBotFollow);
		If(Not(Is True For Any(All Players(Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer))), And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element)))));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, AllowDummyBotFollow, False);
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen, (Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage == 2)));
		If(And((Global.ActivePlayer.CameraCursor >= 2), ((Global.ActivePlayer.CameraCursor - 2) < Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets))));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraTargetCandidate, Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets[(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraCursor - 2)]);
		Else;
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraTargetCandidate, Null);
		End;
		Call Subroutine(RefreshActivePlayerPublicTargets);
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.InspectionTargets);
		If(And((Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargetCandidate != Null), Array Contains(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargetCandidate)));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraCursor, (Index Of Array Value(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargetCandidate) + 2));
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.CameraCursor >= (Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.CameraTargets) + 2)));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, CameraCursor, 0);
		End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen, (Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage == 4)));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeCursor < Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets)));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, SelectedRevengeTarget, Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets[Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeCursor]);
		Else;
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, SelectedRevengeTarget, Null);
		End;
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, RevengeTargets, Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, (Current Array Element != Global.ActivePlayer)));
		If((Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets) == 0));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, RevengeCursor, 0);
		Else If(And((Global.ActivePlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget != Null), Array Contains(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget)));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, RevengeCursor, Index Of Array Value(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets, Global.ActivePlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget));
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeCursor >= Count Of(Global.ActivePlayer.RevengeTargets)));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, RevengeCursor, 0);
		End;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("75 - Subroutine: Process the Try Your Luck state machine")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessPlayerLuck;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, And(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer)))));
		If(And(((Global.SchedulerStep % 4) == (Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot % 4)), And((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount > 0), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime))));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon != Null));
		Destroy Icon(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon);
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect = Random Integer(1, 6);
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 1));
		Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + (Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4))), Eye, Visible To and Position, Color(Aqua), True);
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2));
		Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + (Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4))), Dizzy, Visible To and Position, Color(Violet), True);
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 3));
		Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + (Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4))), Skull, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(255, 70, 70, 255), True);
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 4));
		Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + (Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4))), Heart, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(70, 255, 110, 255), True);
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5));
		Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + (Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4))), Fire, Visible To and Position, Color(Orange), True);
		Else;
		Create Icon(Global.HumanPlayers, Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) + (Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)) * 4))), Poison 2, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(170, 80, 255, 255), True);
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon = Last Created Entity;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
		Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)]] = Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon;
		End;
		Modify Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, LuckSpinCount, Subtract, 1);
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime = (Total Time Elapsed + Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinInterval);
		Modify Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, LuckSpinInterval, Add, 0.045);
		End;
		If(And((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount == 0), And((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime == 0), And((Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime > 0), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime)))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
		If(Or(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 1), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2)), Or((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 6))));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.MenuHud != Null));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuHud);
		End;
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds)));
		Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuHud = Null;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuInputLocked = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuCommand = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuPage = -1;
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ultimate));
		End;
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 1));
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive = True;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 15);
		Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: ALL PLAYER/BOT NAMES — 15s"));
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2));
		Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 1000);
		Start Accelerating(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer), Facing Direction Of(Evaluate Once(Global.ActivePlayer)), 50, 25, To World, Direction Rate and Max Speed);
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 10);
		Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, (Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive ? Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: FLIGHT BOOST — 10s") : Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: AIM-STEERED ACCELERATION — 10s")));
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 3));
		Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: SKULL"));
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = Total Time Elapsed;
		Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 5);
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 4));
		Set Player Health(All Living Players(Team Of(Global.ActivePlayer)), 9999);
		Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: HEART — FULL TEAM HEAL"));
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive = False;
		Else If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5));
		Set Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Null, Burning, 10);
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable);
		Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 10);
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = Total Time Elapsed;
		Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: BURNING — 5% MAX HP/s — 10s"));
		Else;
		Set Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Null, Hacked, 5);
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 5);
		Small Message(Global.ActivePlayer, Custom String("TRY YOUR LUCK: HACKED — 5s"));
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 1);
		End;
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman);
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 5));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime > Total Time Elapsed));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime <= Total Time Elapsed));
		If(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer));
		If(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer));
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable);
		Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Damage(Global.ActivePlayer, Global.ActivePlayer, (Max Health(Global.ActivePlayer) * 0.050));
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 1.000);
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman);
		If(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive);
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount == 0));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime > 0));
		If((Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime));
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Burning);
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Hacked);
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2));
		Stop Accelerating(Global.ActivePlayer);
		Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		End;
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] == Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud);
		Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud = Null;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = True;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime > 0));
		If((Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon != Null));
		Destroy Icon(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon);
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
		Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)]] = 0;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
		If(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive));
		If(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.MenuOpen));
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = True;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("76 - Subroutine: Close the menu and restore buttons")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CloseMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds)));
		If((Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] != 0));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)]);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud == Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)]));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Null;
		End;
		End;
		Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud != Null));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage = -1;
		If(Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Melee)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MeleeConsumed = True;
		Else;
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Melee));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MeleeConsumed = False;
		End;
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Jump));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Crouch));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("77 - Subroutine: Draw one active menu HUD")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud != Null));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Null;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(DrawActiveMenuPage);
		Call Subroutine(TransitionMenuColor);
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds)));
		Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("79 - Subroutine: Draw the Soundtrack menu")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawSoundtrackMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create HUD Text(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Null, ((Player Variable(Local Player, CustomSoundtrack) != Null) ? Custom String("") : Global.MenuPageNames[Round To Integer((Player Variable(Local Player, GenreCursor) / 20), Down)])), ((Player Variable(Local Player, CustomSoundtrack) != Null) ? Custom String("") : Custom String("> {0}", Global.GenreNames[Player Variable(Local Player, GenreCursor)]))), Top, 3, Color(White), Custom Color(205, 235, 255, 255), Custom Color(X Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), Y Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), Z Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), 255), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);

rule("80 - Subroutine: Draw the Camera menu")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawCameraMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create HUD Text(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Null, Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("Hold {0}", Input Binding String(Button(Crouch))), Custom String("{0}: next / {1}: prev", Input Binding String(Button(Primary Fire)), Input Binding String(Button(Secondary Fire)))), Custom String("{0}: apply / {1}: back", Input Binding String(Button(Interact)), Input Binding String(Button(Reload)))), Custom String("Hold {0} 0.5s: close", Input Binding String(Button(Melee)))), Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("2 - 3P CAMERA {0}/{1}", (Player Variable(Local Player, CameraCursor) + 1), (Count Of(Player Variable(Local Player, CameraTargets)) + 2)), Custom String("NOW: {0}", ((Player Variable(Local Player, CameraMode) == 0) ? rule("81 - Subroutine: Draw the Name Color menu")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawNameColorMenu;
	}

	actions
	{

rule("84 - Subroutine: Draw the Travel menu")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawTravelMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud != Null));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud);
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Null;
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds)));
		Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCursor %= 5;
		Create HUD Text(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Null, Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("Hold {0} / release: close", Input Binding String(Button(Crouch))), Custom String("{0}: next / {1}: prev", Input Binding String(Button(Primary Fire)), Input Binding String(Button(Secondary Fire)))), Custom String("{0}: use / {1}+{2}: detach", Input Binding String(Button(Interact)), Input Binding String(Button(Crouch)), Input Binding String(Button(Reload)))), Custom String("{0}\n{1}", ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelCursor) == 0) ? Custom String("1/5 | TELEPORT: SPAWN ROOM") : ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelCursor) == 1) ? Custom String("2/5 | TELEPORT: OBJECTIVE") : ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelCursor) == 2) ? Custom String("3/5 | TELEPORT TO PLAYER/BOT") : ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelCursor) == 3) ? Custom String("4/5 | ATTACH TO PLAYER/BOT") : Custom String("5/5 | SELF ELIMINATION"))))), ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelCursor) == 0) ? Custom String("TEAM SPAWN") : ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelCursor) == 1) ? Custom String("") : ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelCursor) == 2) ? Custom String("BESIDE: {0}", ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelTargetCandidate) != Null) ? Player Variable(Local Player, TravelTargetCandidate) : Custom String("NO PUBLIC TARGET AVAILABLE"))) : ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelCursor) == 3) ? Custom String("ABOVE: {0}", ((Player Variable(Local Player, TravelTargetCandidate) != Null) ? Player Variable(Local Player, TravelTargetCandidate) : Custom String("NO PUBLIC TARGET AVAILABLE"))) : Custom String("CURRENT HERO FORM | COOLDOWN: 3s")))))), Top, 3, Color(White), Custom Color((190 + (X Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)) * 0.250)), (190 + (Y Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)) * 0.250)), (190 + (Z Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)) * 0.250)), 255), Custom Color(X Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), Y Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), Z Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), 255), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Last Text ID;
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer) < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds)));
		Global.MenuHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("89 - Subroutine: Draw the active page")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawActiveMenuPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == -1));
		Call Subroutine(DrawMainMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 0));
		Call Subroutine(DrawInfoMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 1));
		Call Subroutine(DrawNameColorMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 2));
		Call Subroutine(DrawCameraMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 3));
		Call Subroutine(DrawSoundtrackMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 4));
		Call Subroutine(DrawRevengeMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 5));
		Call Subroutine(DrawUnkillableMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 6));
		Call Subroutine(DrawHeroVoiceMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 7));
		Call Subroutine(DrawPlayerIconMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 10));
		Call Subroutine(DrawLuckMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 11));
		Call Subroutine(DrawVoteMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 13));
		Call Subroutine(DrawGhostFlyMenu);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage == 14));
		Call Subroutine(DrawMultijumpMenu);
		End;
	}
}

rule("91 - Subroutine: Lock the bot while allowing movement")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		LockBot;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If(Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MeleeConsumed = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage = -1;
		Set Primary Fire Enabled(Global.TriggerPlayer, False);
		Set Secondary Fire Enabled(Global.TriggerPlayer, False);
		Set Ability 1 Enabled(Global.TriggerPlayer, False);
		Set Ability 2 Enabled(Global.TriggerPlayer, False);
		Set Ultimate Ability Enabled(Global.TriggerPlayer, False);
		Set Melee Enabled(Global.TriggerPlayer, False);
		Disallow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Primary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 1));
		Disallow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 2));
		Disallow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ultimate));
		Disallow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Melee));
		Disallow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Jump));
		Disallow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Reload));
		Disallow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Interact));
		Set Damage Dealt(Global.TriggerPlayer, 0);
		Set Healing Dealt(Global.TriggerPlayer, 0);
		Set Knockback Dealt(Global.TriggerPlayer, 0);
		Set Damage Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Set Move Speed(Global.TriggerPlayer, 20);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LastHero = Hero Of(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotFollowTarget = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.BotLocked = True;
		Disable Nameplates(Global.TriggerPlayer, Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, Player Variable(Current Array Element, NameplatesDisabled)));
	}
}

rule("93 - Subroutine: Draw the Ghost / Fly menu")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawGhostFlyMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create HUD Text(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Null, Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("Hold {0}", Input Binding String(Button(Crouch))), Custom String("{0}: next / {1}: prev", Input Binding String(Button(Primary Fire)), Input Binding String(Button(Secondary Fire)))), Custom String("{0}: toggle / {1}: back", Input Binding String(Button(Interact)), Input Binding String(Button(Reload)))), Custom String("Hold {0} 0.5s: close", Input Binding String(Button(Melee)))), Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("13 - GHOST MODE / FLY {0}/2", (Player Variable(Local Player, GhostFlyCursor) + 1)), Custom String("WALL PHASING: {0} | FLY MODE: {1}", (Player Variable(Local Player, GhostModeActive) ? Custom String("ON") : Custom String("OFF")), (Player Variable(Local Player, FlyModeActive) ? Custom String("ON") : Custom String("OFF")))), Custom String("> {0}", ((Player Variable(Local Player, GhostFlyCursor) == 0) ? Custom String("WALL PHASING - {0}", (Player Variable(Local Player, GhostModeActive) ? Custom String("TURN OFF") : Custom String("TURN ON"))) : Custom String("FLY MODE - {0}", (Player Variable(Local Player, FlyModeActive) ? Custom String("TURN OFF") : Custom String("TURN ON")))))), Custom String("> {0}", ((Player Variable(Local Player, GhostFlyCursor) == 0) ? Custom String("") : Custom String("KEEP MOVING: 100% > 1000% / 20s")))), Top, 3, Color(White), Custom Color(215, 235, 255, 255), Custom Color(X Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), Y Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), Z Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), 255), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Last Text ID;
	}
}

rule("94 - Subroutine: Recount votes and determine a sole leader")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RecountVotes;
	}

	actions
	{
		For Global Variable(VoterIndex, 0, Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers), 1);
		Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], VoteCount, Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, (Player Variable(Current Array Element, VotedPlayer) == Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex]))));
		End;
		Global.VoteLeader = Null;
		Global.HighestVoteCount = 0;
		Global.VoteTied = False;
		Global.VoteLeaderName = Custom String("");
		Global.VoteLeaderColor = Color(White);
		If((Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) > 0));
		Global.VoteLeader = First Of(Sorted Array(Global.HumanPlayers, (0 - Player Variable(Current Array Element, VoteCount))));
		Global.HighestVoteCount = Player Variable(Global.VoteLeader, VoteCount);
		If((Global.HighestVoteCount > 0));
		Global.VoteTied = (Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, (Player Variable(Current Array Element, VoteCount) == Global.HighestVoteCount))) > 1);
		If(Global.VoteTied);
		Global.VoteLeader = Null;
		End;
		Else;
		Global.VoteLeader = Null;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.VoteLeader != Null));
		Global.VoteLeaderName = Player Variable(Global.VoteLeader, DisplayName);
		Global.VoteLeaderColor = Player Variable(Global.VoteLeader, NameColor);
		End;
	}
}

rule("95 - Subroutine: Start the dynamic left shoulder camera")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		StartCamera;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If((Global.CameraPlayer == Null));
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.CameraPlayer)));
		Abort If((Global.CameraPlayer.CameraMode == 0));
		Abort If((Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget == Null));
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.CameraPlayer.CameraTarget)));
		Start Camera(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), Update Every Frame(First Of(Mapped Array(Array(Ray Cast Hit Position((Eye Position(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, (0.450 + ((Max Health(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) - 200) * 0.0006)))), 0)), (((Eye Position(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, (0.450 + ((Max Health(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) - 200) * 0.0006)))), 0)) - (Facing Direction Of(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) * Min(4.500, Max(Global.CameraDistance, (Global.CameraDistance + ((Max Health(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) - 200) * 0.0055)))))) + (Cross Product(Direction From Angles(Horizontal Facing Angle Of(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)), 0), Vector(0, 1, 0)) * Min(1.350, Max(Global.CameraOffset, (Global.CameraOffset + ((Max Health(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) - 200) * 0.0016)))))), Empty Array, Empty Array, False)), (Current Array Element + (Direction Towards(Current Array Element, (Eye Position(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, (0.450 + ((Max Health(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) - 200) * 0.0006)))), 0))) * Min(Global.CameraWallPadding, (Distance Between(Current Array Element, (Eye Position(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) + Vector(0, Min(0.750, Max(0.450, (0.450 + ((Max Health(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) - 200) * 0.0006)))), 0))) * 0.250))))))), Update Every Frame((Eye Position(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) + (Facing Direction Of(Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.CameraPlayer), CameraTarget)) * Global.AimDistance))), 0);
	}
}

rule("96 - Subroutine: Quiesce the trigger player before cleanup")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		QuiescePlayer;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.SuperPunchPlayers = Remove From Array(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Call Subroutine(CloseMenu);
		Call Subroutine(CleanupObjectiveIcon);
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Melee));
		Stop Camera(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Stop Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Stop Chasing Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer, MenuColor);
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentActive);
		Detach Players(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		End;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget = Null;

		Call Subroutine(RestorePlayerLuck);
		Stop Accelerating(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Set Move Speed(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Set Gravity(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeDeathPending = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeClaimant = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuInputLocked = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MeleeConsumed = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCommand = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextTargetTextTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ReviveTeleportNeeded = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraInteractConsumed = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AllowDummyBotFollow = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostModeActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyModeActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpEnabled = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpLevel = 1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpConsumed = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.JumpWasGrounded = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextMultijumpTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ObjectiveIconPosition = Vector(0, 0.500, 0);

		Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsClassified = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot = False;
	}
