rule("97 - Subroutine: Clear references to players who actually left")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CleanupPlayer;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.SuperPunchPlayers = Remove From Array(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.CleanupSubject = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Call Subroutine(CleanupObjectiveIcon);
		Global.LeavingPlayerIndex = Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.CleanupSubject);
		If((Global.LeavingPlayerIndex > -1));
		If(Or((Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots)), Or((Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= Count Of(Global.PlayerListHudIds)), Or((Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds)), (Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds))))));
		Global.CleanupPlayerIndex = Global.LeavingPlayerIndex;
		Global.LeavingPlayerIndex = -2;
		End;
		If((Global.LeavingPlayerIndex >= 0));
		Global.CleanupPlayerIndex = Global.LeavingPlayerIndex;
		Global.LeavingDebtIndex = Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex];
		Global.MissingHudDeadlines[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] = 0;
		If((Global.LuckIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] != 0));
		Destroy Icon(Global.LuckIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex]);
		End;
		Global.LuckIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] = 0;
		If((Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] != 0));
		Destroy Icon(Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex]);
		End;
		Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] = 0;
		If((Global.CleanupSubject.LuckEffectHud != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] == Global.CleanupSubject.LuckEffectHud));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.CleanupSubject.LuckEffectHud);
		Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.CleanupSubject.LuckVisionText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] == Global.CleanupSubject.LuckVisionText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.CleanupSubject.LuckVisionText);
		Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.CleanupSubject.TravelText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] == Global.CleanupSubject.TravelText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.CleanupSubject.TravelText);
		Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.CleanupSubject)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.CleanupSubject.LuckIcon = Null;
		Global.CleanupSubject.UnkillableIcon = Null;
		Global.CleanupSubject.LuckEffectHud = Null;
		Global.CleanupSubject.LuckVisionText = Null;
		Global.CleanupSubject.TravelText = Null;
		Global.CleanupSubject.PlayerListHud = Null;
		Global.CleanupSubject.MenuHud = Null;
		Global.CleanupSubject.InspectionText = Null;
		Global.CleanupSubject.PlayerHudCreated = False;
		Global.CleanupSubject.IsClassified = False;
		Set Player Variable(Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, (Player Variable(Current Array Element, VotedPlayer) == Global.CleanupSubject)), VotedPlayer, Null);
		For Global Variable(VoterIndex, 0, Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers), 1);
		If((Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex] != Global.CleanupSubject));
		Global.LeavingRevengeIndex = Index Of Array Value(Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeKillers), Global.CleanupSubject);
		If(And((Global.LeavingRevengeIndex >= 0), (Global.LeavingRevengeIndex < Count Of(Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeDebts)))));
		Modify Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeKillers, Remove From Array By Index, Global.LeavingRevengeIndex);
		Modify Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeDebts, Remove From Array By Index, Global.LeavingRevengeIndex);
		End;
		If((Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], LockedRevengeTarget) == Global.CleanupSubject));
		Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], LockedRevengeTarget, Null);
		End;
		If((Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], SelectedRevengeTarget) == Global.CleanupSubject));
		Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], SelectedRevengeTarget, Null);
		End;
		If((Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeClaimant) == Global.CleanupSubject));
		Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeClaimant, Null);
		Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], RevengeDeathPending, False);
		Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], NextForcedRevengeTime, 0);
		Set Player Variable(Global.HumanPlayers[Global.VoterIndex], ForcedRevengeEndTime, 0);
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.PlayerListHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.PlayerListHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
		End;
		If((Global.MenuHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.MenuHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
		End;
		If((Global.InspectionTextIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.InspectionTextIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
		End;
		Global.AvailableHudSlots = Sorted Array(Append To Array(Global.AvailableHudSlots, Global.LeavingDebtIndex), Current Array Element);
		Modify Global Variable(PlayerListHudIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		Modify Global Variable(MenuHudIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		Modify Global Variable(InspectionTextIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		Modify Global Variable(PlayerHudSlots, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		Modify Global Variable(HumanPlayers, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		Global.VoterIndex = Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots);
		Global.LastHudSlot = ((Global.VoterIndex == 0) ? -1 : Last Of(Sorted Array(Global.PlayerHudSlots, Current Array Element)));
		Global.VoteRecountNeeded = True;
		End;
		If((Global.LeavingPlayerIndex == -2));
		If((Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots)));
		Destroy Icon(Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]]);
		Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]] = 0;
		End;
		If((Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots)));
		Destroy Icon(Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]]);
		Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]] = 0;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectHud != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] == Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectHud));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectHud);
		Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] == Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText);
		Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] == Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText);
		Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIcon = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectHud = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerListHud = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerHudCreated = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsClassified = False;
		If((Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.PlayerListHudIds)));
		If((Global.PlayerListHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.PlayerListHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
		End;
		Modify Global Variable(PlayerListHudIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		End;
		If((Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.MenuHudIds)));
		If((Global.MenuHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.MenuHudIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
		End;
		Modify Global Variable(MenuHudIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		End;
		If((Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.InspectionTextIds)));
		If((Global.InspectionTextIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex] != 0));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.InspectionTextIds[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex]);
		End;
		Modify Global Variable(InspectionTextIds, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		End;
		If((Global.CleanupPlayerIndex < Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots)));
		Global.LeavingDebtIndex = Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.CleanupPlayerIndex];
		Global.MissingHudDeadlines[Global.LeavingDebtIndex] = 0;
		Modify Global Variable(PlayerHudSlots, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		Global.AvailableHudSlots = Append To Array(Global.AvailableHudSlots, Global.LeavingDebtIndex);
		Global.AvailableHudSlots = Sorted Array(Global.AvailableHudSlots, Current Array Element);
		End;
		Modify Global Variable(HumanPlayers, Remove From Array By Index, Global.CleanupPlayerIndex);
		Global.VoterIndex = Count Of(Global.PlayerHudSlots);
		Global.LastHudSlot = ((Global.VoterIndex == 0) ? -1 : Last Of(Sorted Array(Global.PlayerHudSlots, Current Array Element)));
		Global.VoteRecountNeeded = True;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Call Subroutine(CleanupOrphanedText);
		Global.LeavingPlayerIndex = -1;
		Global.CleanupPlayerIndex = -1;
		Global.LeavingDebtIndex = -1;
		Global.LeavingRevengeIndex = -1;
		Global.VoterIndex = 0;
		Global.CleanupSubject = Null;
	}
}

rule("98 - Subroutine: Clean up orphaned text")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CleanupOrphanedText;
	}

	actions
	{
		For Global Variable(TextCleanupCursor, 0, Count Of(Global.TemporaryTextOwners), 1);
		If(Or((Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != Null), Or((Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0), Or((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0), (Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0)))));
		If(Or(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupCursor])), And((Global.TextCleanupPlayer != Null), (Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupCursor] == Global.TextCleanupPlayer))));
		If((Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor]);
		End;
		If((Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor]);
		End;
		If((Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] != 0));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor]);
		End;
		Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] = 0;
		Global.TemporaryTravelTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] = 0;
		Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Global.TextCleanupCursor] = 0;
		Global.TemporaryTextOwners[Global.TextCleanupCursor] = Null;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TextCleanupPlayer = Null;
		Global.TextCleanupIndex = -1;
		Global.TextCleanupCursor = 0;
	}
}

rule("99 - Subroutine: Prepare the player and initialize variables")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		PreparePlayer;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Set Damage Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Stop Accelerating(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Set Move Speed(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Set Gravity(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AutoHeroSelectionDeadline = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AutoHeroSelectionComplete = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsClassified = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreIndex = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CustomSoundtrack = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerListUpdatePending = False;
		If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName == Null), (Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName == Custom String(""))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName = Null;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerListHud = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerHudCreated = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GenreCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextTargetTextTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionText = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTarget = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MeleeConsumed = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuPage = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MainMenuCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ColorIndex = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NameColor = Color(White);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets = Empty Array;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets = Empty Array;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeKillers = Empty Array;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeDebts = Empty Array;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeIndex = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeDeathPending = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeClaimant = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargets = Empty Array;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTextTarget = Null;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelType = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceIndex = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VoiceCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelCommand = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraInteractConsumed = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.DeathPosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ReviveTeleportNeeded = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.JumpReviveConsumed = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IconIndex = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IconCursor = 0;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelEnabled = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionPrivacyActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableMode = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.UnkillableIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)]] = 0;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)]] = 0;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VoteCursor = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VotedPlayer = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.VoteCount = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckSpinCount = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckSpinInterval = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffect = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckPrivacyActive = False;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextLuckSpinTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.LastTeam = Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer);

		Global.TriggerPlayer.DummyBotTravelTime = 0;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextMultijumpTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ObjectiveIconPosition = Vector(0, 0.500, 0);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.GhostFlyPhysicsApplied = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextSuicideTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyRampStartTime = -1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyPercent = 100;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyDirection = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.FlyVelocityDelta = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentChain = Null;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentCycleDetected = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate = Null;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentTarget = Null;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.AttachmentOwnerHero = Null;

		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleDeadline = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.WasPrepared = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamChangeProcessed = True;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.PlayerCycleActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.IsPrepared = True;
	}
}

rule("100 - Subroutine: Refresh camera targets, including bots")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshCameraTargets;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor >= 2), ((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor - 2) < Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate = Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets[(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor - 2)];
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate = Null;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(RefreshPlayerPublicTargets);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets = Filtered Array(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargets, Has Spawned(Current Array Element));
		If(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate != Null), Array Contains(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets, Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor = (Index Of Array Value(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets, Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargetCandidate) + 2);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor >= (Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraTargets) + 2)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraCursor = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("101 - Subroutine: Find the nearest public inspection target under the crosshair")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshInspectionTarget;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate == Null), Or(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate)), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate)), Or(Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate)), And(And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate)), Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate, IsAutomaticBot))), Or(Not(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate, IsHuman)), Or(Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate, InspectionPrivacyActive), Player Variable(Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate, PlayerListUpdatePending)))))))));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget = Null;
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargetCandidate;
		End;
	}
}

rule("102 - Subroutine: Refresh Revenge targets")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshRevengeTargets;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor < Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget = Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets[Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor];
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget = Null;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets = Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, (Current Array Element != Global.TriggerPlayer));
		If((Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets) == 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor = 0;
		Else If(And((Global.TriggerPlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget != Null), Array Contains(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets, Global.TriggerPlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor = Index Of Array Value(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets, Global.TriggerPlayer.SelectedRevengeTarget);
		Else If((Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor >= Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeTargets)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.RevengeCursor = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("103 - Subroutine: Find the nearest public Travel target under the crosshair")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshTravelTarget;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(RefreshPlayerPublicTargets);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargets = Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargets;
		If((Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargets) == 0));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate = Null;
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargetCandidate = First Of(Sorted Array(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargets, Angle Between Vectors(Facing Direction Of(Global.TriggerPlayer), Direction Towards(Eye Position(Global.TriggerPlayer), Eye Position(Current Array Element)))));
		End;
	}
}

rule("104 - Subroutine: Restore Luck state for the trigger player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RestorePlayerLuck;
	}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIcon != Null));
		Destroy Icon(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIcon);
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectHud != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] == Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectHud));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectHud);
		Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] == Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText);
		Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.TriggerPlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)]] = 0;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectHud = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText = Null;
		Clear Status(Global.TriggerPlayer, Burning);
		Clear Status(Global.TriggerPlayer, Hacked);
		Clear Status(Global.TriggerPlayer, Unkillable);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffect == 2));
		Stop Accelerating(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Set Move Speed(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		End;
		Set Damage Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Set Jump Vertical Speed(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Set Projectile Speed(Global.TriggerPlayer, 100);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckSpinCount = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckSpinInterval = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffect = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckPrivacyActive = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextLuckSpinTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableActive = (Global.TriggerPlayer.UnkillableMode != 0);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuInputLocked = False;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand = 0;
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("105 - Subroutine: Restore Luck state for the globally active player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RestoreActivePlayerLuck;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or((Global.ActivePlayer == Null), Not(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer))));
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon != Null));
		Destroy Icon(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon);
		End;
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] == Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud));
		Destroy HUD Text(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud);
		Global.TemporaryEffectHudIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckVisionText != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] == Global.ActivePlayer.LuckVisionText));
		Destroy In-World Text(Global.ActivePlayer.LuckVisionText);
		Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, Global.ActivePlayer)] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIcon = Null;
		If(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer));
		Global.LuckIconIds[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Index Of Array Value(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ActivePlayer)]] = 0;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectHud = Null;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckVisionText = Null;
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Burning);
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Hacked);
		If(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode == 0), Not(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer))));
		Clear Status(Global.ActivePlayer, Unkillable);
		Set Damage Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.ActivePlayer);
		End;
		If((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect == 2));
		Stop Accelerating(Global.ActivePlayer);
		Set Move Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		End;
		Set Jump Vertical Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Set Projectile Speed(Global.ActivePlayer, 100);
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckActive = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinCount = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckSpinInterval = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckPrivacyActive = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckBurnTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextLuckSpinTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckIconEndTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextForcedRevengeTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.ForcedRevengeEndTime = 0;
		Global.ActivePlayer.LuckMenuReopenNeeded = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableActive = (Global.ActivePlayer.UnkillableMode != 0);
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuInputLocked = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MenuCommand = 0;
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("106 - Subroutine: Refresh public targets for the trigger player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshPlayerPublicTargets;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.TriggerPlayer.InspectionTargets = Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And((Current Array Element != Global.TriggerPlayer), And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), Or(Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element), Or(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsAutomaticBot), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman), And(Not(Player Variable(Current Array Element, InspectionPrivacyActive)), Not(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PlayerListUpdatePending))))))))));
	}
}

rule("107 - Subroutine: Refresh public targets for the globally active player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RefreshActivePlayerPublicTargets;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or((Global.ActivePlayer == Null), Not(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer))));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ActivePlayer, InspectionTargets, Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And((Current Array Element != Global.ActivePlayer), And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), Or(Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element), Or(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsAutomaticBot), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman), And(Not(Player Variable(Current Array Element, InspectionPrivacyActive)), Not(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PlayerListUpdatePending)))))))))));
	}
}

rule("108 - Subroutine: Create a dummy bot for the active team")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CreateTeamDummyBot;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create Dummy Bot(All Heroes, Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam, -1, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam))), Vector(0, 0, 1));
	}
}

rule("109 - Subroutine: Remove a dummy bot from the active team")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		RemoveTeamDummyBot;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If((Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))) == 0));
		If((Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))), LuckVisionText) != Null));
		If((Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element)))) >= 0));
		If((Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))))] == Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))), LuckVisionText)));
		Destroy In-World Text(Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))), LuckVisionText));
		Global.TemporaryVisionTextIds[Index Of Array Value(Global.TemporaryTextOwners, First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))))] = 0;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Stop Facing(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))));
		Stop Throttle In Direction(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element))));
		Destroy Dummy Bot(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam, Slot Of(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.ActiveDummyBotTeam), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element)))));
	}
}

rule("110 - Subroutine: Travel to spawn")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TravelToSpawn;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is In Spawn Room(Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Already in Spawn Room. Home sweet home!"));
		Else If((Count Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer))) == 0));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Spawn Room unavailable."));
		Else;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode != 0));
		Stop Camera(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		End;
		Teleport(Global.TriggerPlayer, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)))));
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode != 0));
		Global.CameraPlayer = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
		Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("111 - Subroutine: Travel to the objective")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TravelToObjective;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination = Objective Position(Objective Index);
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Objective unavailable."));
		Abort;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("No safe walkable spot near the objective."));
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode != 0));
		Stop Camera(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		End;
		Teleport(Global.TriggerPlayer, Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode != 0));
		Global.CameraPlayer = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
		Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("112 - Subroutine: Travel to the target player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TravelToPlayer;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Or(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget == Null), Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget))), Or(Not(Is Alive(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget)), Not(Array Contains(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelTargets, Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget)))));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("Target unavailable. Teleport has standards."));
		Abort;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination = (Position Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget) - (Facing Direction Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget) * 2.250));
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination = (Position Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget) + (Facing Direction Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget) * 2.250));
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination = (Position Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget) + Vector(2.250, 0, 0));
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination = (Position Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget) + Vector(-2.250, 0, 0));
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination = (Position Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget) + Vector(0, 0, 2.250));
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination = (Position Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.LockedTravelTarget) + Vector(0, 0, -2.250));
		Call Subroutine(FindSafeTravelPosition);
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Small Message(Global.TriggerPlayer, Custom String("No safe walkable spot near that target."));
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode != 0));
		Stop Camera(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		End;
		Teleport(Global.TriggerPlayer, Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition);
		If((Global.TriggerPlayer.CameraMode != 0));
		Global.CameraPlayer = Global.TriggerPlayer;
		Call Subroutine(StartCamera);
		Global.CameraPlayer = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("113 - Subroutine: Find a safe Travel position")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		FindSafeTravelPosition;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination);
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(1.500, 1, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0))) < 1.250));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(-1.500, 0, 0)));
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(-1.500, 1, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0))) < 1.250));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(1.500, 0, 0)));
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 1.500)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0))) < 1.250));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0, -1.500)));
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, -1.500)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0))) < 1.250));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Nearest Walkable Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0, 1.500)));
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(1.000, 1, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0))) < 0.850));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(-1.000, 1, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0))) < 0.850));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 1.000)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0))) < 0.850));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, -1.000)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0))) < 0.850));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.250, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 2.500, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.250, 0))) < 2.000));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination) > 8));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 5, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition - Vector(0, 20, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition) > 6));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelDestination + Vector(0, 1, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1, 0))) > 0.750));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100));
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(1.500, 1.000, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0))) < 1.250));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(-1.500, 1.000, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0))) < 1.250));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 1.500)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0))) < 1.250));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, -1.500)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 1.000, 0))) < 1.250));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position((Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.500, 0)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 2.750, 0)), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), (Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition + Vector(0, 0.500, 0))) < 2.000));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.SafeRevivePosition += Vector(0, 0.500, 0);
		End;
	}
}

rule("114 - Subroutine: Apply the Multijump choice")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplyMultijumpPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpCursor %= 11;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpEnabled = (Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpCursor != 0);
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpEnabled);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpLevel = Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpCursor;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MultijumpConsumed = Is Button Held(Global.TriggerPlayer, Button(Jump));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.JumpWasGrounded = Is On Ground(Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.NextMultijumpTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.300);
	}
}

rule("115 - Subroutine: Draw Multijump choices")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		DrawMultijumpMenu;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create HUD Text(Evaluate Once(Global.TriggerPlayer), Null, Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("{0} | {1}", Custom String("Hold {0}", Input Binding String(Button(Crouch))), Custom String("{0}: next / {1}: prev", Input Binding String(Button(Primary Fire)), Input Binding String(Button(Secondary Fire)))), Custom String("{0}: toggle / {1}: back", Input Binding String(Button(Interact)), Input Binding String(Button(Reload)))), Custom String("Hold {0} 0.5s: close", Input Binding String(Button(Melee)))), Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("{0}\n{1}", Custom String("14 - MULTIJUMP {0}/11", (Player Variable(Local Player, MultijumpCursor) + 1)), Custom String("NOW: {0} | AIR BOOST: {1}%", (Player Variable(Local Player, MultijumpEnabled) ? Custom String("ON") : Custom String("OFF")), (Player Variable(Local Player, MultijumpLevel) * 100))), Custom String("> {0}", ((Player Variable(Local Player, MultijumpCursor) == 0) ? Custom String("OFF") : Custom String("AIR BOOST: {0}%", (Player Variable(Local Player, MultijumpCursor) * 100))))), Custom String("> {0}", ((Player Variable(Local Player, MultijumpCursor) == 0) ? Custom String("") : Custom String("IN AIR: TAP / HOLD JUMP")))), Top, 3, Color(White), Custom Color(215, 235, 255, 255), Custom Color(X Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), Y Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), Z Component Of(Player Variable(Local Player, MenuColor)), 255), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuHud = Last Text ID;
	}
}

rule("116 - Subroutine: Repeat air jumps with a cooldown")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessMultijump;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is Button Held(Global.ActivePlayer, Button(Jump)));
		If(Or(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed), (Total Time Elapsed >= Global.ActivePlayer.NextMultijumpTime)));
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextMultijumpTime = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.300);
		If(And(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman, And(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer), And(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer), And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.FlyModeActive), And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.TravelAttachmentActive), And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.JumpReviveConsumed), And(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffect != 2), (Global.ActivePlayer.LuckEffectEndTime <= Total Time Elapsed)), Or(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed), And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.JumpWasGrounded), Not(Is On Ground(Global.ActivePlayer))))))))))));
		Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed = True;
		If(And(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.JumpWasGrounded), Not(Is On Ground(Global.ActivePlayer))));
		Apply Impulse(Global.ActivePlayer, ((((6 * Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpLevel) - Y Component Of(Velocity Of(Global.ActivePlayer))) >= 0) ? Vector(0, 1, 0) : Vector(0, -1, 0)), Absolute Value(((6 * Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpLevel) - Y Component Of(Velocity Of(Global.ActivePlayer)))), To World, Incorporate Contrary Motion);
		End;
		Play Effect(All Players(All Teams), Ring Explosion, Global.RGB, (Position Of(Global.ActivePlayer) + Vector(0, 0.050, 0)), 1.500);
		Else;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed = True;
		End;
		End;
		Else;
		Global.ActivePlayer.MultijumpConsumed = False;
		Global.ActivePlayer.NextMultijumpTime = 0;
		End;
		Global.ActivePlayer.JumpWasGrounded = Is On Ground(Global.ActivePlayer);
	}
}

rule("117 - Subroutine: Apply the Super Punch toggle")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ApplySuperPunchPage;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot < 0), (Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot >= 12)));
		If(Array Contains(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer));
		Modify Global Variable(SuperPunchPlayers, Remove From Array By Value, Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot] = 0;
		Else;
		Modify Global Variable(SuperPunchPlayers, Append To Array, Global.TriggerPlayer);
		Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot] = -1;
		End;
	}
}

rule("118 - Subroutine: Apply Super Punch once per swing")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessSuperPunch;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or((Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot < 0), (Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot >= Count Of(Global.SuperPunchTimes))));
		If((Is Meleeing(Global.ActivePlayer) == False));
		Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot] = 0;
		Abort;
		End;
		If(Or(Not(Global.ActivePlayer.IsHuman), Or(Global.ActivePlayer.IsAutomaticBot, Or(Is Dummy Bot(Global.ActivePlayer), Or(Not(Entity Exists(Global.ActivePlayer)), Or(Not(Has Spawned(Global.ActivePlayer)), Or(Not(Is Alive(Global.ActivePlayer)), Or(Global.ActivePlayer.PlayerCycleActive, Or(Global.ActivePlayer.TeamChangeProcessed, Global.ActivePlayer.MeleeConsumed)))))))));
		Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot] = -1;
		Abort;
		End;
		If((Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot] == 0));
		Global.SuperPunchTarget = First Of(Sorted Array(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And((Current Array Element != Global.ActivePlayer), And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Has Spawned(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), And((Distance Between(Position Of(Global.ActivePlayer), Position Of(Current Array Element)) <= 2.500), And(Is In View Angle(Global.ActivePlayer, Eye Position(Current Array Element), 90), Is In Line Of Sight(Eye Position(Global.ActivePlayer), Eye Position(Current Array Element), Barriers Do Not Block LOS)))))))), Distance Between(Position Of(Global.ActivePlayer), Position Of(Current Array Element))));
		If((Global.SuperPunchTarget != Null));
		Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActivePlayer.HudSlot] = -1;
		End;
		If(And((Global.SuperPunchTarget != Null), And(Entity Exists(Global.SuperPunchTarget), And(Has Spawned(Global.SuperPunchTarget), And(Is Alive(Global.SuperPunchTarget), And(Not(Has Status(Global.SuperPunchTarget, Phased Out)), And(Not(Has Status(Global.SuperPunchTarget, Unkillable)), Or(Not(Player Variable(Global.SuperPunchTarget, UnkillableActive)), (Player Variable(Global.SuperPunchTarget, UnkillableMode) == 0)))))))));
		Kill(Global.SuperPunchTarget, Global.ActivePlayer);
		End;
		Global.SuperPunchTarget = Null;
		End;
	}
}

rule("119 - Super Punch: Handle native melee impact")
{
	event
	{
		Player Dealt Damage;
		All;
		All;
		}

	conditions
	{
		Global.IsReady == True;
		Array Contains(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Event Player) == True;
		Event Ability == Button(Melee);
		Hero Of(Event Player) != Hero(Junker Queen);
		Event Damage > 0;
		Event Player.IsHuman == True;
		Event Player.IsAutomaticBot == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Entity Exists(Event Player) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.PlayerCycleActive == False;
		Event Player.TeamChangeProcessed == False;
		Event Player.MeleeConsumed == False;
		Victim != Null;
		Victim != Event Player;
		Entity Exists(Victim) == True;
		Has Spawned(Victim) == True;
		Is Alive(Victim) == True;
		}

	actions
	{
		If((Global.EventCount < 192));
		Global.EventQueue[Global.EventQueueTail] = Array(6, Event Player, Null, Victim, Event Ability, Event Damage, Null, Total Time Elapsed, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Null, Or(Has Status(Victim, Phased Out), Or(Has Status(Victim, Unkillable), And(Player Variable(Victim, UnkillableActive), (Player Variable(Victim, UnkillableMode) != 0)))), Event Player.HudSlot, Null, Hero Of(Event Player), Team Of(Event Player), Event Player.ControllerState[36], (Event Player.IsHuman ? Event Player.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Event Player)), Player Variable(Victim, ControllerState)[36]);
		Global.EventQueueTail = ((Global.EventQueueTail + 1) % 256);
		Global.EventCount += 1;
		Else;
		Global.DroppedEventCount += 1;
		End;
	}
}

rule("120 - Super Punch: Handle native melee impact global")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		NativeEvent89i1;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[20] != Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[36]));
		Abort If((Global.ActiveEvent[21] != (Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman ? Global.TriggerPlayer.DisplayName : Custom String("{0}", Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Abort If(Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.LastTeam != Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer)), (Global.TriggerPlayer.TeamCycleTargetTeam != Team Of(Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Abort If((Global.TriggerPlayer.HudSlot != Global.ActiveEvent[16]));
		Abort If(Not(Array Contains(Global.SuperPunchPlayers, Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Abort If(Or((Global.ActiveEvent[16] < 0), (Global.ActiveEvent[16] >= Count Of(Global.SuperPunchTimes))));
		Abort If((Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActiveEvent[16]] < 0));
		Global.SuperPunchTimes[Global.ActiveEvent[16]] = -1;
		If(And(Not(Global.ActiveEvent[15]), And(Entity Exists(Global.ActiveEvent[3]), And(Has Spawned(Global.ActiveEvent[3]), And(Is Alive(Global.ActiveEvent[3]), And((Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[3], ControllerState)[36] == Global.ActiveEvent[22]), And(Not(Has Status(Global.ActiveEvent[3], Phased Out)), And(Not(Has Status(Global.ActiveEvent[3], Unkillable)), Or(Not(Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[3], UnkillableActive)), (Player Variable(Global.ActiveEvent[3], UnkillableMode) == 0))))))))));
		Kill(Global.ActiveEvent[3], Global.TriggerPlayer);
		End;
	}
}

rule("121 - Subroutine: Maintain floating objective icons once per second")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		UpdateSocialObjectiveIcons;
	}

	actions
	{
		For Global Variable(ObjectiveIconIndex, 0, 12, 1);
		If(And((Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != Null), Not(And(Entity Exists(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]), And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]), And(Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], IsHuman), And(Not(Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], PlayerListUpdatePending)), And(Not(Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], TeamChangeProcessed)), (Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], IconIndex) > 0)))))))));
		If((Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != 0));
		Destroy Icon(Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]);
		End;
		If(Entity Exists(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]));
		Stop Chasing Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition);
		Set Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
		End;
		Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
		Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
		Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = Null;
		Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
		End;
		If(And((Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == Null), (Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100)));
		Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = First Of(Filtered Array(Global.HumanPlayers, And((Player Variable(Current Array Element, HudSlot) == Global.ObjectiveIconIndex), And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, IsHuman), And(Not(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PlayerListUpdatePending)), And(Not(Player Variable(Current Array Element, TeamChangeProcessed)), (Player Variable(Current Array Element, IconIndex) > 0))))))));
		If((Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != Null));
		Set Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, ((Direction From Angles(Random Real(0, 360), 0) * Random Real(0, 10)) + Vector(0, Random Real(0.500, 8), 0)));
		Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = Total Time Elapsed;
		Chase Player Variable Over Time(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, ((Direction From Angles(Random Real(0, 360), 0) * Random Real(0, 10)) + Vector(0, Random Real(0.500, 8), 0)), 4.500, None);
		End;
		End;
		If((Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != Null));
		If((Total Time Elapsed >= (Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] + 3)));
		Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = Total Time Elapsed;
		Chase Player Variable Over Time(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, ((Direction From Angles(Random Real(0, 360), 0) * Random Real(0, 10)) + Vector(0, Random Real(0.500, 8), 0)), 4.500, None);
		End;
		If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], IconIndex)));
		If((Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != 0));
		Destroy Icon(Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]);
		End;
		Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
		Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], IconIndex);
		End;
		Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer = Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex];
		If((Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 0));
		If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 1));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 1)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Arrow: Down, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);
		Else If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 2));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 2)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Arrow: Left, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);
		Else If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 3));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 3)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Arrow: Right, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);
		Else If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 4));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 4)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Arrow: Up, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);
		Else If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 5));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 5)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Asterisk, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);
		Else If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 6));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 6)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Bolt, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);
		Else If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 7));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 7)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Checkmark, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);
		Else If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 8));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 8)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Circle, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);
		Else If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 9));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 9)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Club, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);
		Else If((Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == 10));
		Create Icon((And(Entity Exists(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer)), (Global.VisibleIconChoices[Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconIndex)] == 10)) ? All Players(All Teams) : Empty Array), (Objective Position(Objective Index) + Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), ObjectiveIconPosition)), Diamond, Visible To Position and Color, Player Variable(Evaluate Once(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), NameColor), False);

rule("122 - Subroutine: Remove the objective icon on departure or team change")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CleanupObjectiveIcon;
	}

	actions
	{
		For Global Variable(ObjectiveIconIndex, 0, 12, 1);
		If((Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] == Global.TriggerPlayer));
		If((Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] != 0));
		Destroy Icon(Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]);
		End;
		If(Entity Exists(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex]));
		Stop Chasing Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition);
		Set Player Variable(Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex], ObjectiveIconPosition, Vector(0, 0.500, 0));
		End;
		Global.ObjectiveIconIds[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
		Global.ObjectiveIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
		Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = Null;
		Global.ObjectiveIconTimes[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = 0;
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("123 - Subroutine: Control players from global context")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessGlobalController;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Not(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		If((Count Of(Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState) < 37));
		Global.ControllerGeneration += 1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState = Empty Array;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[36] = Global.ControllerGeneration;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerTimes = Empty Array;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(Controller01a);
		Call Subroutine(Controller01b);
		Call Subroutine(Controller02);
		If(Or(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer), Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot));
		Call Subroutine(Controller03c);
		Call Subroutine(Controller03f);
		Call Subroutine(Controller03g);
		Call Subroutine(Controller03h);
		Call Subroutine(Controller18i);
		Call Subroutine(Controller18j);
		Else If(And(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsHuman, And(Not(Is Dummy Bot(Global.TriggerPlayer)), Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.IsAutomaticBot))));
		Call Subroutine(Controller05);
		Call Subroutine(Controller05b);
		If(Or(Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuOpen, Or((Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuCommand != 0), Global.TriggerPlayer.MenuInputLocked)));
		Call Subroutine(Controller05c);
		Call Subroutine(Controller05d);
		Call Subroutine(Controller05e);
		Call Subroutine(Controller05f);
		Call Subroutine(Controller06);
		Call Subroutine(Controller08);
		Call Subroutine(Controller10);
		Call Subroutine(Controller11);
		Else;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[13] = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[14] = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[15] = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[16] = 0;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(Controller12c);
		Call Subroutine(Controller12d);
		Call Subroutine(Controller12f);
		Call Subroutine(Controller12g);
		Call Subroutine(Controller13);
		Call Subroutine(Controller18c);
		Call Subroutine(Controller18g);
		If(Or((Count Of(Global.LuckVisionViewers) > 0), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText != Null), (Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText != 0))));
		Call Subroutine(Controller18i);
		End;
		If(Or((Count Of(Global.LuckVisionViewers) > 0), And((Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText != Null), (Global.TriggerPlayer.LuckVisionText != 0))));
		Call Subroutine(Controller18j);
		End;
		Call Subroutine(Controller18k);
		Call Subroutine(Controller19);
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive);
		Call Subroutine(Controller19a);
		Call Subroutine(Controller19b);
		Call Subroutine(Controller19c);
		Call Subroutine(Controller19d);
		Call Subroutine(Controller19e);
		Call Subroutine(Controller19g);
		End;
		If(Not(Global.TriggerPlayer.CrouchTravelActive));
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[30] = 0;
		Global.TriggerPlayer.ControllerState[32] = 0;
		End;
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentActive);
		Call Subroutine(Controller19f);
		End;
		If(Global.TriggerPlayer.TravelAttachmentActive);
		Call Subroutine(Controller19h);
		End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("124 - Subroutine: Drain the native event queue")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessGlobalEventQueue;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.InitialEventCount = Global.EventCount;
		For Global Variable(EventCursor, 0, Global.InitialEventCount, 1);
		Global.ActiveEvent = Global.EventQueue[Global.EventQueueHead];
		Global.EventQueue[Global.EventQueueHead] = Null;
		Global.EventQueueHead = ((Global.EventQueueHead + 1) % 256);
		Global.EventCount -= 1;
		Global.TriggerPlayer = Global.ActiveEvent[1];
		If((Global.ActiveEvent[0] == 0));
		Call Subroutine(NativeEvent03i);
		Else If((Global.ActiveEvent[0] == 1));
		Call Subroutine(NativeEvent04);
		Else If((Global.ActiveEvent[0] == 2));
		Call Subroutine(NativeEvent12e);
		Else If((Global.ActiveEvent[0] == 3));
		Call Subroutine(NativeEvent16a);
		Else If((Global.ActiveEvent[0] == 4));
		Call Subroutine(NativeEvent17);
		Else If((Global.ActiveEvent[0] == 5));
		Call Subroutine(NativeEvent18f);
		Else If((Global.ActiveEvent[0] == 6));
		Call Subroutine(NativeEvent89i1);
		End;
		End;
		Global.TriggerPlayer = Null;
		Global.ActiveEvent = Null;
	}
}

rule("125 - Subroutine: Reconcile departed players from global context")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessGlobalLeaves;
	}

	actions
	{
		For Global Variable(PendingLeaveCursor, 0, Count Of(Global.PendingLeaves), 1);
		If((Global.PendingLeaves[Global.PendingLeaveCursor] != Null));
		Global.ActiveEvent = Global.PendingLeaves[Global.PendingLeaveCursor];
		If((Total Time Elapsed >= (Global.ActiveEvent[7] + 0.500)));
		Global.TriggerPlayer = Global.ActiveEvent[1];
		Global.PendingLeaves[Global.PendingLeaveCursor] = Null;
		If(Not(And(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer), Array Contains(Global.PlayerListSnapshot, Global.TriggerPlayer))));
		Call Subroutine(CleanupPlayer);
		End;
		End;
		End;
		End;
		If(((Global.SchedulerStep % 20) == 0));
		For Global Variable(MissingPlayerCursor, (Count Of(Global.HumanPlayers) - 1), -1, -1);
		Global.TriggerPlayer = Global.HumanPlayers[Global.MissingPlayerCursor];
		If(And(Entity Exists(Global.TriggerPlayer), Array Contains(Global.PlayerListSnapshot, Global.TriggerPlayer)));
		Global.MissingHudDeadlines[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.MissingPlayerCursor]] = 0;
		Else If((Global.MissingHudDeadlines[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.MissingPlayerCursor]] == 0));
		Global.MissingHudDeadlines[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.MissingPlayerCursor]] = (Total Time Elapsed + 0.500);
		Else If((Total Time Elapsed >= Global.MissingHudDeadlines[Global.PlayerHudSlots[Global.MissingPlayerCursor]]));
		Call Subroutine(CleanupPlayer);
		End;
		End;
		End;
		Global.ActiveEvent = Null;
		Global.TriggerPlayer = Null;
	}
}

rule("126 - Subroutine: Cache visible objective icon choices")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		ProcessVisibleIcons;
	}

	actions
	{
		For Global Variable(ObjectiveIconIndex, 0, 12, 1);
		Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer = Global.ObjectiveIconOwners[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex];
		Global.VisibleIconChoices[Global.ObjectiveIconIndex] = (And(Entity Exists(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), And(Array Contains(Global.HumanPlayers, Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer), And(Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer.IsHuman, (Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100)))) ? Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer.IconIndex : 0);
		End;
		Global.ObjectiveIconPlayer = Null;
	}
}
